name: L001-1
title: BAB/L/001 No. 1, 4 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/001, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110000065.
% The cover (image 222/593) lists the sheet's two programs; this is the first,
% the upper table of the opened sheet (image 222/594, top half).
% Read from the zoom images at full resolution. Accents are written ': b' is b′.

Sheet BAB/L/001
No. 1
Date 4 Aug 1837          "No 1. 4 Aug 1837."   % cover; also "4 Aug 1837" at the top right of the table
Title "Elimination between two equations of the first degree ax + by + c = 0  a'x + b'y + c' = 0 which is equivalent to calculating the value of x from the eqn x = (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba')"
Image 222/593 cover
Image 222/594 upper table

Letters a b c a' b' c'
Unknowns x y
Equation a x + b y + c = 0
Equation a' x + b' y + c' = 0
Find x = (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba')    "x = bc'-b'c / b'a-ba'"   % the heading, and the cover

% "The number of variables = 6 viz v1=a, v2=b, v3=c; v4=a', v5=b', v6=c'"  (cover)
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = a', v5 = b', v6 = c'
Working v7

% Columns: Numbers of Operations | Nature of oper. | variables in Mill | Store v1..v7 | right-hand column.
% Store columns are headed +ax +by +c (v1 v2 v3), +a'x +b'y +c' (v4 v5 v6), v7.
% A store cell is written only where the sheet writes one.
Op 1     ×  | b'a                 | v1 0, v5 0, v7 b'a        | v7 = v5·v1
Op 2     ×  | b'c                 | v1 b'c, v3 0              | v1' = v5·v3
Op 3     ×  | ba'                 | v2 0, v3 ba', v4 0        | v3' = v2·v4
Op 4     ×  | bc'                 | v2 bc', v6 0              | v2' = v2·v6
Op 5     −  | bc'-b'c             | v1 0, v2 0, v4 bc'-b'c    | v4' = v2'-v1'
Op 6     −  | b'a-ba'             | v1 b'a-ba', v3 0, v7 0    | v1'' = v7-v3'
Op 7  *  ÷  | (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba') | v1 0, v3 =x, v4 0         | x = v3'' = v4'/v1''

Composition x = v3'' = v4'/v1'' = (v2'-v1')/(v7-v3') = (v2·v6-v5·v3)/(v5·v1-v2·v4) = (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba')

% "Number of operations great = 5 small = 2 Total number of operations = 7
%  Number of variables = 6 No of working variables = 1 Total number of variables occupied = 7"
% The same figures are on the cover.
States great 5, small 2, total 7, variables 6, working 1, occupied 7

Remark "It at first appeared that variables v7 and v3' might have been saved by making b'a-ba' at the fourth operation but this would have caused the table of b' made in the third operation to be destroyed and it must have been recomputed in the operation for b'c thus causing the loss of about ten turns of the hand."

name: L001-2
title: BAB/L/001 No. 2, 5 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/001, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110000065.
% The second program of the sheet: the lower table of the opened sheet
% (image 222/594, bottom half). The cover dates it "No 2. Aug. 5"; the table
% itself is not dated. Read from the zoom images at full resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/001
No. 2
Date 5 Aug 1837          "No 2. Aug. 5"   % cover
Title "Elimination between two equations of the first degree ax + by + c = 0 & a'x + b'y + c' = 0 which is equivalent to calculating x & y from the equations x = (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba') & y = (a'c-ac')/(b'a-ba')"
Image 222/593 cover
Image 222/594 lower table
Image 222/595 back: "C, C or C before any number signifies the Complement of that number as Ca means complement of a"

Letters a b c a' b' c'
Unknowns x y
Equation a x + b y + c = 0
Equation a' x + b' y + c' = 0
Find x = (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba')
Find y = (a'c-ac')/(b'a-ba')

Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = a', v5 = b', v6 = c'
Working v7 v8 v9

% Ca, Cc, Cb: written with a looped capital C, which the back of the sheet defines.
% Rows 8-10 have no operation and nothing in the mill column.
Op 1     ×  | b'a                 | v1 0, v5 0, v7 b'a, v8 Ca          | v7 = v5·v1
Op 2     ×  | b'c                 | v1 b'c, v3 0, v5 Cc                | v1' = v5·v3
Op 3     ×  | ba'                 | v2 0, v3 ba', v4 0, v9 Cb          | v3' = v2·v4
Op 4     ×  | bc'                 | v2 bc', v6 0                       | v2' = v2·v6
Op 5     −  | bc'-b'c             | v1 0, v2 0, v6 bc'-b'c             | v6' = v2'-v1'
Op 6     −  | b'a-ba'             | v2 b'a-ba', v3 0, v7 0             | v2'' = v7-v3'
Op 7  *  ÷  | (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba') | v2 0, v4 =x, v6 0, v7 =x           | x = v4' = v6'/v2''
Op 8        |                     | v1 a, v8 0                         | v1'' = v1 = a
Op 9        |                     | v2 b, v9 0                         | v2''' = v2 = b
Op 10       |                     | v3 c, v5 0                         | v3'' = v3 = c
Op 11    ×  | ax                  | v1 0, v4 0, v5 ax                  | v5'' = v1''·v4'
Op 12    −  | -c-ax               | v1 -c-ax, v3 0, v5 0               | v1''' = -v3''-v5''
Op 13 *  ÷  | (-c-ax)/b           | v1 0, v2 0, v5 =y                  | y = v5''' = v1'''/v2'''

% "Composition"
Composition x = v4' = v6'/v2'' = (v2'-v1')/(v7-v3') = (v2·v6-v5·v3)/(v5·v1-v2·v4) = (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba')
Composition y = v5''' = v1'''/v2''' = (-v3''-v5'')/b = (-c-v1''·v4')/b = (-c-ax)/b = (-c-a(bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba'))/b = (-cb'a+cba'-c'ba+cb'a)/(b(b'a-ba')) = (a'c-ac')/(b'a-ba')

% "Number of operations great = 7 small = 6 Total number of operations = 13
%  Number of variables = 6 No of working variables = 3 Total no of variables occupied = 9"
% The same figures are on the cover.
States great 7, small 6, total 13, variables 6, working 3, occupied 9

Unrun "pencil, right of the counts: '6 Mult = 18 / 1 Div = 5 / 6 add = 1', ruled off, '24'; a word above the column of figures, perhaps 'Mov'"
Unrun "pencil, beside the right-hand column: the value of each operation in letters (= b'a, = b'c, ...)"
Unrun "pencil, faint, centre: 'ε^(a + bx + cx² + ...) = A + Bx + Cx² + ...'"
Unrun "pencil, foot of the sheet: '085', '075 035', '6 66', 'a fa fa·a' (unclear)"

name: L002
title: BAB/L/002 No. 2, 14 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/002, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110000066.
% The opened sheet (image 222/624), one table of 30 operations. The cover
% (222/622) is dated "14 Aug 1837 No 2". Read from the zoom images at full
% resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/002
No. 2
Date 14 Aug 1837          "14 Aug 1837 No 2"   % cover
Title "Computation of λ0, λ1, λ2, &c from (A0 + A1x + A2x² + &c)/(a + bx) = λ0 + λ1x + λ2x² + &c by Means of the relation λm = (Am - bλm-1)/a = Nm/a & λ0 = A0/a"
Image 222/622 cover: "Notation for the coeffecients of the powers of x in (A0 + A1x + A2x² + .... Aix^i)/(a + bx) = λ0 + λ1x + λ2x² .... λmx^m, where λ0 = A0/a and λm = (Am - bλm-1)/a"
Image 222/624 the table
Image 222/626 back

Letters a b A0 A1 A2 A3 A4 A5 A6
Find λ0 = A0/a

% The sheet heads v1 "a", v2 "b", and v8 to v14 "A0" to "A6"; v3 to v7 have
% no heading.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v8 = A0, v9 = A1, v10 = A2, v11 = A3, v12 = A4, v13 = A5, v14 = A6
Working v3 v4 v5 v6 v7

% The table has no right-hand column of formulas: each row is the operation,
% the mill's result and the cells. "Com a" and "Com b" are written so, not
% with the looped C of BAB/L/001; here Ca and Cb. λ and N are the sheet's;
% =λ1 marks where the sheet first writes λ1, so that later rows can use it.
% A mark like > stands left of the operation column between operations 1
% and 2, 5 and 6, 10 and 11, 15 and 16, 20 and 21, 25 and 26: before each
% bringing in of b, where each cycle begins.
Op 1     ÷  | A0/a      | v1 0, v3 Ca, v6 =λ0, v7 λ0, v8 0 |
Op 2     ×  | bλ0       | v1 Cb, v2 0, v4 bλ0, v6 0 |
Op 3     −  | A1-bλ0    | v4 0, v5 =N1, v9 0 |
Op 4        |           | v2 a, v3 0 |
Op 5     ÷  | N1/a      | v2 0, v3 Ca, v5 0, v6 =λ1, v8 λ1 |   % the mill's N has no legible subscript
Op 6        |           | v1 0, v2 b |
Op 7     ×  | bλ1       | v1 Cb, v2 0, v4 bλ1, v6 0 |
Op 8     −  | A2-bλ1    | v4 0, v5 =N2, v10 0 |
Op 9        |           | v2 a, v3 0 |
Op 10    ÷  | N2/a      | v2 0, v3 Ca, v5 0, v6 =λ2, v9 λ2 |
Op 11       |           | v1 0, v2 b |
Op 12    ×  | bλ2       | v1 Cb, v2 0, v4 bλ2, v6 0 |
Op 13    −  | A3-bλ2    | v4 0, v5 =N3, v11 0 |   % the sign is − with a pencil stroke through it, which makes it look like +
Op 14       |           | v2 a, v3 0 |
Op 15    ÷  | N3/a      | v2 0, v3 Ca, v5 0, v6 =λ3, v10 λ3 |
Op 16       |           | v1 0, v2 b |
Op 17    ×  | bλ3       | v1 Cb, v2 0, v4 bλ3, v6 0 |
Op 18    −  | A4-bλ3    | v4 0, v5 =N4, v12 0 |
Op 19       |           | v2 a, v3 0 |
Op 20    ÷  | N4/a      | v2 0, v3 Ca, v5 0, v6 =λ4, v11 λ4 |
Op 21       |           | v1 0, v2 b |
Op 22    ×  | bλ4       | v1 Cb, v2 0, v4 bλ4, v6 0 |
Op 23    −  | A5-bλ4    | v4 0, v5 =N5, v13 0 |
Op 24       |           | v2 a, v3 0 |
Op 25    ÷  | N5/a      | v2 0, v3 Ca, v5 0, v6 =λ5, v12 λ5 |
Op 26       |           | v1 0, v2 b |
Op 27    ×  | bλ5       | v1 Cb, v2 0, v4 bλ5, v6 0 |   % "Com b" in v1 is faint, lighter than the rest
Op 28    −  | A6-bλ5    | v4 0, v5 =N6, v14 0 |
Op 29       |           | v2 a, v3 0 |
Op 30    ÷  | N6/a      | v2 0, v5 0, v13 =λ6 |   % no Com a, and nothing in v6: a and λ6 are not needed again

% Not on the sheet, an observation: the last division lays no complement of
% a and writes λ6 only in v13, and operation 27's Com b is faint; a and b are
% kept only while a later operation needs them.
Unrun "a column of numbers 1 to 30 between v13 and v14, repeating the numbers of the operations"
Unrun "cover, pencil, faint, read in part: '1 Division gets λ0'; '1 Multiplication {2} Subtraction {3} Bring in a number 4 Division gets λ1 = 2 large & 2 small = 4 operations'; '1 Bring in a number 2 Multiplication {3} Subtraction {4} Bring in a number 5 Division gets λm = 2 large & 3 small = 5 operations' (the counts not certain)"
Unrun "cover, pencil, faint: a ruled grid of four labelled rows of 0s and 1s, the first label perhaps 'Division', the last perhaps 'General'; not read"
example: (2 + 3x + 3x² + 3x³ + 3x⁴ + 3x⁵ + x⁶)/(2 + x) = 1 + x + x² + x³ + x⁴ + x⁵ (λ6 = 0)

name: L004-1
title: BAB/L/004 No. 4.1, 16 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/004, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001607.
% The first of three tables on the opened sheet (image 222/630, top left).
% The cover (222/628), headed "Notation", "16 Aug 1837 No 4", numbers the
% three 1, 2, 3; the sheet is dated "16 Augt 1837" at its top left and
% "Aug 1837" at its top right. Read from the zoom images at full resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/004
No. 4.1
Date 16 Aug 1837          "16 Aug 1837 No 4"   % cover
Title "Determination of x from the Equation ax - b = 0"
Image 222/628 cover: "1. of the determination of x from the equation ax - b = 0", "1 Division"
Image 222/630 the first table
Image 222/632 back: "No 4 16 Aug 1837"

Letters a b
Unknowns x
Equation a x - b = 0

% The columns are headed "+ax" and "+b" (the sign before b read as +,
% though the equation is ax - b = 0), with v1, v2 beneath; v3 has no heading.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b
Working v3

Op 1     ÷  | b/a       | v1 0, v2 0, v3 =x |      % the mill column reads "b/a = x"

% Cover: "a great operation = 1"; "variables = 2 / working do = 1 / total var. = 3".
States great 1, variables 2, working 1, occupied 3

Unrun "a pencil stroke, like a long 0 or bracket, in the column left of v1"

name: L004-2
title: BAB/L/004 No. 4.2, 16 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/004, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001607.
% The second of three tables on the opened sheet (image 222/630, middle
% left), and the "Composition" to the right of it. Numbered 2 on the cover.
% Read from the zoom images at full resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/004
No. 4.2
Date 16 Aug 1837          "16 Aug 1837 No 4"   % cover
Title "Reduction of the two equations ax + by + c = 0, a'x + b'y + c' = 0 to a single equation of the form Hx - M = 0"
Image 222/628 cover: "2. Reduction of the two Equations ax + by + c = 0 & a'x + b'y + c' = 0 to a single one of the form Hx - M = 0"
Image 222/630 the second table and the composition

Letters a b c a' b' c' x
Unknowns x y
Equation a x + b y + c = 0
Equation a' x + b' y + c' = 0

Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = a', v5 = b', v6 = c'
Working v7

% No right-hand column of formulas. The mill column writes "b'/b = A",
% "Aa - a' = H", "c' - Ac = M"; the cells "A", "H", "M". =A, =H, =M mark
% where the sheet first writes each.
% In pencil, fainter than the ink: "v8" at the head of a column after v7,
% "A" in it at row 1 and "0" at row 3; and "M" in v7 at row 5. Not run.
Op 1     ÷  | b'/b      | v2 0, v5 0, v7 =A |
Op 2     ×  | Aa        | v1 0, v2 Aa, v7 0 |
Op 3     ×  | Ac        | v3 0, v5 Ac |             % nothing else in the row: A is in no column (v7 was left at zero by row 2)
Op 4     −  | Aa-a'     | v1 =H, v2 0, v4 0 |       % the species "−" has a pencil mark beside it
Op 5     −  | c'-Ac     | v2 =M, v5 0, v6 0 |

% "Composition", to the right of the table:
%   v1 = a  v2 = b  v3 = c  v4 = a'  v5 = b'  v6 = c'
%   v7 = v5/v2;  v2' = v7 v1;  v3' = v7 v3;  v1' = v2' - v4;  v2'' = v6 - v5'
% (the table writes Ac in v5, not v3: the composition calls it v3' here and
% v5' in the next line). Then "result = v1'x + v2'' = …"; the word
% "result" is left out here, so that the chain starts at v1'x + v2''.
Composition v1'x + v2'' = (v2'-v4)x - (v6-v3') = (v7v1-a')x - (c'-v7v3) = ((v5/v2)a-a')x - (c'-(v5/v2)v3) = ((b'/b)a-a')x - (c'-(b'/b)c) = (ab'-a'b)x - (bc'-b'c) = 0
% Each member after the first is written "= 0" on the sheet, so the chain is
% of equations (the last, b times the one before it, agrees as one).

% Cover, right of 2: "variables = 6 / working do = 1 / Total do = 7";
% "great op. = 3 / small do = 2 / Total operations = 5".
States great 3, small 2, total 5, variables 6, working 1, occupied 7

Remark "The reduction is effected by making the coeffecient of one of the unknowns in one of the equations equal to the coeffecient of the same unknown in the other equation and subtracting the results as ax + by + c = 0, a'x + b'y + c' = 0; (b'/b).ax + (b'/b).by + (b'/b).c = 0, a'x + b'y + c' = 0 whence ((b'/b)a - a')x - (c' - (b'/b)c) = 0 or Hx - M = 0"
Remark "Had H = b'a - ba' M = bc' - b'c 4 Multns must have been made instead of 2 —— and 1 Division"
Unrun "cover, pencil, faint: a ruled grid, columns headed 1 to 5 and a total; four labelled rows of 0s and 1s with totals 2, 2, 2 and 0 (labels perhaps Division, Multiplication, Subtraction and a fourth); not read with certainty"

name: L004-3
title: BAB/L/004 No. 4.3, 16 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/004, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001607.
% The third of three tables on the opened sheet (image 222/630, lower
% left). Numbered 3 on the cover. Read from the zoom images at full
% resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/004
No. 4.3
Date 16 Aug 1837          "16 Aug 1837 No 4"   % cover
Title "Reduction of the same two equations ax + by + c = 0, a'x + b'y + c' = 0 to a single equation of the form Ky - M = 0"
Image 222/628 cover: "3 Reduction of the same two Equations, viz ax + by + c = 0 & a'x + b'y + c' = 0 to a single one of the form Ky - M = 0" (K written over H)
Image 222/630 the third table

Letters a b c a' b' c'
Unknowns x y
Equation a x + b y + c = 0
Equation a' x + b' y + c' = 0

Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = a', v5 = b', v6 = c'
Working v7

% No right-hand column, no composition. The mill column writes "a'/a = A",
% "Ab - b' = K", "c' - Ac = -M"; the cells "A", "K", "-M".
Op 1     ÷  | a'/a      | v1 0, v4 0, v7 =A |
Op 2     ×  | Ab        | v1 Ab, v2 0, v7 0 |
Op 3     ×  | Ac        | v3 0, v4 Ac |             % nothing else in the row: A is in no column (v7 was left at zero by row 2)
Op 4     −  | Ab-b'     | v1 0, v2 =K, v5 0 |
Op 5     −  | c'-Ac     | v3 c'-Ac, v4 0, v6 0 |    % the mill writes "c' - Ac = -M", the cell "-M"

% Cover, right of 3: "var. and opns as in 2", that is:
States great 3, small 2, total 5, variables 6, working 1, occupied 7

name: L005
title: BAB/L/005 No. 5, 16 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/005, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001611.
% The opened sheet (image 222/636), one table of 34 operations. The cover
% (222/634) is dated "16 Aug 1837 No 5"; the table "16 Aug 1837" at its top
% right; the back (222/638) "No 5 16 Aug 1837". Read from the zoom images at
% full resolution. ∂ on the sheet is written d here.

Sheet BAB/L/005
No. 5
Date 16 Aug 1837          "16 Aug 1837 No 5"   % cover
Title "Reductions of the three equations ax + by + cz + d = 0, a'x + b'y + c'z + d' = 0, a''x + b''y + c''z + d'' = 0 to two equations of the form Hx + Ky + M = 0 and H'x + K'y + M' = 0"
Image 222/634 cover: "Notation For the Reduction of the Three Equations ... To Two equations of the form Hx + Ky + M = 0, H'x + K'y + M' = 0. Mode of operation made use of in this Notation: (c'+c'')/c and (c+c'')/c' are calculated"
Image 222/636 the table
Image 222/638 back: "No 5 16 Aug 1837"

Letters a b c d a' b' c' d' a'' b'' c'' d''

% The cover: "whence ((c'+c'')/c a - a' - a'')x + ((c'+c'')/c b - b' - b'')y
% + ((c'+c'')/c d - d' - d'') = 0 or Hx + Ky + M = 0", and the same with
% (c+c'')/c' for H', K', M'.
Find H = (c'+c'')/c·a-a'-a''
Find K = (c'+c'')/c·b-b'-b''
Find M = (c'+c'')/c·d-d'-d''
Find H' = (c+c'')/c'·a'-a-a''
Find K' = (c+c'')/c'·b'-b-b''
Find M' = (c+c'')/c'·d'-d-d''

% The store is headed +ax +by +cz +d over v1-v4, +a'x +b'y +c'z +d' over
% v5-v8, +a''x +b''y +c''z +d'' over v9-v12, and, above the right-hand
% column, "v1 = a v2 = b ... v12 = d''". v13-v15 have no heading.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = d, v5 = a', v6 = b', v7 = c', v8 = d', v9 = a'', v10 = b'', v11 = c'', v12 = d''
Working v13 v14 v15

% "Com. c'" and the like are written in words; here Cc'. Rows with no
% species and nothing in the mill column are transfers. The mill column
% writes "= A", "= B", "= H" and so on under rows 6, 7, 14, 16, 18, 30, 32,
% 34; the store cells write "= A", "= B" in rows 6 and 7 and H, K, M, M',
% K', H' in rows 14 to 34; the column before the right-hand one writes
% "H =", "K =", "M =", "M' =", "K' =", "H' =".
Op 1     +  | c'+c''      | v7 0, v11 0, v13 c'+c'', v14 Cc', v15 Cc''   | v13 = v7+v11
Op 2        |             | v7 c', v14 0                                 | v7' = c'
Op 3        |             | v11 c'', v15 0                               | v11' = c''
Op 4     +  | c+c''       | v3 0, v11 0, v14 Cc, v15 c+c''               | v15' = v3+v11'
Op 5        |             | v3 c, v14 0                                  | v3' = c
Op 6     ÷  | (c'+c'')/c  | v3 0, v11 =A, v13 0                          | v11'' = v13/v3'
Op 7     ÷  | (c+c'')/c'  | v7 0, v13 =B, v15 0                          | v13' = v15'/v7'
Op 8     ×  | Aa          | v1 0, v7 Ca, v11 0, v15 Aa                   | v15'' = v11''·v1
Op 9     ×  | Ab          | v2 0, v3 Cb, v14 Ab                          | v14'' = v11''·v2
Op 10    ×  | Ad          | v1 Ad, v4 0, v11 Cd                          | v1' = v11''·v4
Op 11    −  | Aa-a'       | v2 Aa-a', v4 Ca', v5 0, v15 0                | v2' = v15''-v5
Op 12    −  | Ab-b'       | v5 Cb', v6 0, v14 0, v15 Ab-b'               | v15''' = v14''-v6
Op 13    −  | Ad-d'       | v1 0, v6 Cd', v8 0, v14 Ad-d'                | v14''' = v1'-v8
Op 14    −  | Aa-a'-a''   | v1 =H, v2 0, v8 Ca'', v9 0                   | H = v1'' = v2'-v9
Op 15       |             | v3 0, v9 b                                   | v9' = b
Op 16    −  | Ab-b'-b''   | v2 =K, v3 Cb'', v10 0, v15 0                 | K = v2'' = v15'''-v10
Op 17       |             | v3 0, v10 b''                                | v10' = b''
Op 18    −  | Ad-d'-d''   | v3 =M, v12 0, v14 0, v15 Cd''                | M = v3'''' = v14'''-v12   % the species looks like "="
Op 19       |             | v14 d'', v15 0                               | v14'''' = d''
Op 20       |             | v8 0, v12 a''                                | v12' = a''
Op 21       |             | v6 0, v8 d'                                  | v8'' = d'
Op 22       |             | v5 0, v6 b'                                  | v6'' = b'
Op 23       |             | v4 0, v5 a'                                  | v5'' = a'
Op 24       |             | v4 a, v7 0                                   | v4'' = a
Op 25       |             | v7 d, v11 0                                  | v7''' = d
Op 26    ×  | Ba'         | v5 0, v11 Ba', v13 0                         | v11'''' = v13'·v5''
Op 27    ×  | Bb'         | v6 0, v15 Bb'                                | v15''''' = v13'·v6''
Op 28    ×  | Bd'         | v5 Bd', v8 0                                 | v5''' = v13'·v8''
Op 29    −  | Bd'-d       | v5 0, v7 0, v8 Bd'-d                         | v8''' = v5'''-v7'''       % a small mark above the −
Op 30    −  | Bd'-d-d''   | v7 =M', v8 0, v14 0                          | M' = v7'''' = v8'''-v14''''
Op 31    −  | Bb'-b       | v5 Bb'-b, v9 0, v15 0                        | v5'''' = v15'''''-v9'
Op 32    −  | Bb'-b-b''   | v5 0, v6 =K', v10 0                          | K' = v6''' = v5''''-v10'
Op 33    −  | Ba'-a       | v4 0, v8 Ba'-a, v11 0                        | v8'''' = v11''''-v4''

% The right-hand column continues on rows 14, 16, 18, 30, 32 and 34. The
% sheet writes accents iv and v as roman numerals; here as primes.

Composition M = v3'''' = v14'''-v12 = (v1'-v8)-d'' = v11''·v4-d'-d'' = v13/v3'·d-d'-d'' = (v7+v11)/c·d-d'-d'' = (c'+c'')/c·d-d'-d'' = (d(c'+c'')-c(d'+d''))/c

% Pencil on the cover, in a hand unlike Babbage's ink: "15 variables are
% required & 26 small operations & 8 large = 34 operations - There are 6
% Multiplications & 2 divisions".

Remark "resulting equation equivalent to 1/c {a(c'+c'')-c(a'+a'')}x + {b(c'+c'')-c(b'+b'')}y + d(c'+c'')-c(d'+d'') = 0"

text:
% BAB/L/006, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001614.
% The opened sheet (image 222/642), one table of 18 operations. The cover
% (222/640) is marked "No 6" and is not dated; nor is the table. Rojas
% (2017, Table 3) dates program 6 "8.1837". Read from the zoom images at
% full resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/006
No. 6
Title "Notation For the reduction of the three Equations ax + by + cz + d = 0, a'x + b'y + c'z + d' = 0, a''x + b''y + c''z + d'' = 0 To two Equations of the form Hx + Ky + M = 0, H'x + K'y + M' = 0"
Image 222/640 cover: the equations, the "Mode of operating used in this Notation", and a paragraph beginning "The Notation fails"
Image 222/642 the table
Image 222/644 back: "No 6" only

% The sheet writes d as a round-backed ∂; here d.
Letters a b c d a' b' c' d' a'' b'' c'' d''

% The cover: "c'/c and c''/c are calculated", "whence (c'/c a - a')x +
% (c'/c b - b')y + (c'/c d - d'')= 0 or Hx + Ky + M = 0" (the cover writes
% d'' in the first and c''/c before by in the line above it, where the
% working needs d' and c'/c; the table has neither slip), "also ... whence
% (c''/c a - a'')x + (c''/c b - b'')y + (c''/c d - d'')= 0 or H'x + K'y + M' = 0".
Find H = (c'/c)a-a'
Find K = (c'/c)b-b'
Find M = (c'/c)d-d'
Find H' = (c''/c)a-a''
Find K' = (c''/c)b-b''
Find M' = (c''/c)d-d''

% The store is headed with the three equations, ax +by +cz +d = 0 over
% v1 to v4, a'x +b'y +c'z +d' = 0 over v5 to v8, a''x +b''y +c''z +d'' = 0
% over v9 to v12; then v13 to v18.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = d, v5 = a', v6 = b', v7 = c', v8 = d', v9 = a'', v10 = b'', v11 = c'', v12 = d''
Working v13 v14 v15 v16 v17 v18

% The right-hand column is headed "Composition". The sheet writes each row
% with the formula first and the variable written last ("v7/v3 = v13",
% "v13·v1 = v7/v3 v1 = v7'"); here the variable written comes first, as the
% notation requires, and the rest follows in the sheet's order.
% "Comp. c", "Comp a", "Comp. b", "Comp. ∂" are written in words; here Cc,
% Ca, Cb, Cd. The mill writes c'/c a as a fraction followed by a; here (c'/c)a.
Op 1     ÷  | c'/c          | v3 0, v7 0, v13 c'/c, v14 Cc        | v13 = v7/v3
Op 2     ×  | (c'/c)a       | v1 0, v7 (c'/c)a, v13 0, v15 Ca     | v7' = v13·v1 = v7/v3·v1
Op 3     ×  | (c'/c)b       | v2 0, v13 (c'/c)b, v16 Cb           | v13' = v13·v2 = v7/v3·v2
Op 4     ×  | (c'/c)d       | v4 0, v17 Cd, v18 (c'/c)d           | v18 = v13·v4 = v7/v3·v4
% Rows 5 and 7 to 9: no operation and nothing in the mill. The sheet writes
% "v14 = v3' = v3", "v15 = v1' = v1", "v16 = v2' = v2", "v17 = v4' = v4".
Op 5        |               | v3 c, v14 0                         | v3' = v3
% Row 6's middle member is written v1?/v3 with the second digit of 11
% blotted, perhaps 14 corrected to 11 or the reverse; the same blot is in
% row 11's v1?/v3. Read as v11, which the other rows (v11/v3 in rows 10 and
% 12) have.
Op 6     ÷  | c''/c         | v3 0, v11 0, v14 c''/c              | v14' = v11/v3' = v11/v3
Op 7        |               | v1 a, v15 0                         | v1' = v1
Op 8        |               | v2 b, v16 0                         | v2' = v2
Op 9        |               | v4 d, v17 0                         | v4' = v4
% Rows 10 to 12 name v1, v2, v4 without accents, though each now holds its
% second number (the same a, b, d brought back).
Op 10    ×  | (c''/c)a      | v1 0, v14 0, v15 (c''/c)a           | v15' = v14'·v1 = v11/v3·v1
Op 11    ×  | (c''/c)b      | v2 0, v16 (c''/c)b                  | v16' = v14'·v2 = v11/v3·v2
Op 12    ×  | (c''/c)d      | v4 0, v17 (c''/c)d                  | v17' = v14'·v4 = v11/v3·v4
% Rows 13 to 18: the mill column ends with "=", and the store cell holds the
% letter (H, K, M, H', K', M'); the right-hand column runs on, "= v1'' = H =
% c'/c a - a'".
Op 13    −  | (c'/c)a-a'    | v1 =H, v5 0, v7 0                   | v1'' = v7'-v5 = v7/v3·v1-v5 = H = (c'/c)a-a'
Op 14    −  | (c'/c)b-b'    | v2 =K, v6 0, v13 0                  | v2'' = v13'-v6 = v7/v3·v2-v6 = K = (c'/c)b-b'
Op 15    −  | (c'/c)d-d'    | v4 =M, v8 0, v18 0                  | v4'' = v18-v8 = v7/v3·v4-v8 = M = (c'/c)d-d'
% Row 16's mill: the second letter's first accent touches its bowl, so that
% it could be taken for d''; the sheet's d is always the round-backed ∂, and
% the right-hand column has c''/c a - a''. Read as a''.
Op 16    −  | (c''/c)a-a''  | v5 =H', v9 0, v15 0                 | v5' = v15'-v9 = v11/v3·v1-v9 = H' = (c''/c)a-a''
Op 17    −  | (c''/c)b-b''  | v6 =K', v10 0, v16 0                | v6' = v16'-v10 = v11/v3·v2-v10 = K' = (c''/c)b-b''
Op 18    −  | (c''/c)d-d''  | v8 =M', v12 0, v17 0                | v8' = v17'-v12 = v11/v3·v4-v12 = M' = (c''/c)d-d''

% The cover, in a paler hand (pencil or faded ink): "This requires 18
% variables - 10 small & 8 large operations = 18 Operations There are 8
% multiplications & 2 divisions - See Not. 5".
States great 8, small 10, total 18, occupied 18

Remark "When H/H' = K/K' = G then G = M/M' or when H/H' = K/K' = M/M'"
Remark "The Notation fails - The failure is not a necessary consequence of the method made use of in the Not - but the fault lies in the given equations"
Remark "In the method, the coeffts. of z in the 2nd & 3rd equations are divided by that of z in the 1st - the former quot. multiplied into the 1st equation equalizes the coeffts of z in the 2nd & the resulting eqn"
% The table has 6 multiplications and 2 divisions: 8 great operations, as
% "8 large operations" says, but not "8 multiplications & 2 divisions".
Unrun "cover: 'There are 8 multiplications & 2 divisions - See Not. 5'"
Unrun "cover, pencil, left margin beside the second 'whence': 'also'"
Unrun "table, faint pencil in the empty column after the mill, row 7: perhaps 'ca - ch' (not read)"

% BAB/L/008, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001622.
% Cover 222/658 ("No 8 Aug 20th /37"); the table in ink 222/659; a draft of
% the same table in pencil, on four-figure wheels, 222/657; backs 222/655 and
% 222/660 ("22 Aug 1837" at the top left of 222/660). Read from the zoom
% images at full resolution. See sources/notes/L008.md.
%
Sheet BAB/L/008
No. 8
Date 20 Aug 1837          "No 8 Aug 20th /37"   % cover; the back of 222/660 reads "22 Aug 1837"
Title "Calculation of a rational Integral Function, of the Second Degree by Differences"
Image 222/658 cover: "Calculation of Tn = n² + 2n + 3 By Differences. T0 = 3, Δ0 = 3, Δ²0 = 3, Δ³n = 0. It requires four operations to obtain each value of Tn or its complement according as n is even or odd"
Image 222/659 the table, its right-hand column, and eight numbered instructions
Image 222/657 a draft of the table in pencil, on four-figure wheels (9998, 9995, ...); not transcribed cell for cell

% Heading of 222/659: "Tn = an² + bn + c. Let a = 1, b = 2, c = 3, then
% Tn = an² + bn + c = 1n² + 2n + 3. T0 = 3, ΔT0 = 3, Δ²T0 = 2".
% (The cover's "Δ²0 = 3" disagrees with the table's Δ²T0 = 2 and with
% n² + 2n + 3, whose second difference is 2. Read again at full size: the
% cover's figure is a 3.)
%
% Columns: number of the turn; a narrow column with a × between turns 4
% and 5, 8 and 9, 12 and 13, and after 16; three columns "Car Car Car"
% under "Carriages Negative"; the store, v1 "Δ²", v2 "Δ", v3 "T", v4, v5,
% an unheaded column, v6 "Δ²", v7 "Δ", v8 "T", v9 to v12 (v4, v5, v9-v12
% empty). Then the right-hand column of formulas.
%
% A small figure after a complement is the number it is the complement of:
% 998₂, 995₅, 994₆, 991₉, 982₁₈. "−0" is a carriage reduced to negative zero.
%
% Each row is a turn of the store with its three negative carriages, on
% three-figure wheels: a complement is 1000 - x. The actions of each turn are
% what the sheet's right-hand column and its numbered instructions (below)
% say is done, in that order; the cells are the figures the table writes.
% A column an action takes a number from is left at zero ("reducing Δ²0 to
% zero"). Rounds of four turns alternate between v1-v3 and v6-v8.
Wheels 3
Let T1 = 1·1 + 2·1 + 3
Let T2 = 2·2 + 2·2 + 3
Let T3 = 3·3 + 2·3 + 3
Let T4 = 4·4 + 2·4 + 3
Store v1 = 002, v2 = 003, v3 = 003
Working v6 v7 v8

Turn 1  | Car1 = Car1 - v1, v6 = Car1, v7 = Car1                 | Car1 998, v1 0, v6 998, v7 998
Turn 2  | Car1 = Car1 - v2, v7 = Car1, Car2 = Car2 - v2           | Car1 995, Car2 997, v2 0, v7 995
Turn 3  | Car3 = Car2, v8 = Car2, Car1 = 0, Car2 = 0              | Car1 -0, Car2 -0, Car3 997, v8 997
Turn 4  | Car3 = Car3 - v3, v8 = Car3                             | Car3 994, v3 0, v8 994
Turn 5  | Car1 = Car1 - v6, v1 = Car1, v2 = Car1                  | Car1 002, v1 002, v2 002, v6 0
Turn 6  | Car1 = Car1 - v7, v2 = Car1, Car2 = Car2 - v7           | Car1 007, Car2 005, v2 007, v7 0
Turn 7  | Car3 = Car2, v3 = Car2, Car1 = 0, Car2 = 0              | Car1 -0, Car2 -0, Car3 005, v3 005
Turn 8  | Car3 = Car3 - v8, v3 = Car3                             | Car3 011, v3 011, v8 0
Turn 9  | Car1 = Car1 - v1, v6 = Car1, v7 = Car1, Car3 = 0        | Car1 998, Car3 -0, v1 0, v6 998, v7 998   % Car3 "−0" faint, in pencil
Turn 10 | Car1 = Car1 - v2, v7 = Car1, Car2 = Car2 - v2           | Car1 991, Car2 993, v2 0, v7 991
Turn 11 | Car3 = Car2, v8 = Car2, Car1 = 0, Car2 = 0              | Car1 -0, Car2 -0, Car3 993, v8 993
Turn 12 | Car3 = Car3 - v3, v8 = Car3                             | Car3 982, v3 0, v8 982
Turn 13 | Car1 = Car1 - v6, v1 = Car1, v2 = Car1, Car3 = 0        | Car1 002, Car3 -0, v1 002, v2 002, v6 0   % Car3 "−0" faint, in pencil
Turn 14 | Car1 = Car1 - v7, v2 = Car1, Car2 = Car2 - v7           | Car1 011, Car2 009, v2 011, v7 0
Turn 15 | Car3 = Car2, v3 = Car2, Car1 = 0, Car2 = 0              | Car1 -0, Car2 -0, Car3 009, v3 009
Turn 16 | Car3 = Car3 - v8, v3 = Car3                             | Car3 027, v3 027, v8 0

% The right-hand column's starred results ("ar Co T1 *", "T2 *", ...;
% turn 12 "Ar. Co. of T3", turn 16 "T4 *"):
Gives 4 v8 = C(T1)
Gives 8 v3 = T2
Gives 12 v8 = C(T3)
Gives 16 v3 = T4

% The cover: "It requires four operations to obtain each value of Tn".

% The right-hand column, by turn (accents on the carriages count their
% numbers, as on BAB/L/001, in turns 1-8; from turn 9 a number in
% parentheses names the turn a number was made in instead):
%   1  1st Car = ar.Co of v1 = v6 = v7 = ar.Co of Δ²
%   2  1st Car' = 1st Car − v2 = v7' = ar.co. of Δ² − Δ0 = ArCo Δ1;  2nd Car = ArCo Δ0 = −v2
%   3  1st Car'' = 0  2nd Car' = 0  3rd Car = 2nd Car = ar Co. Δ0 = v8
%   4  3rd Car' = v8' = 3rd Car − v3 = ar Co Δ0 + ar.Co T0 = ar Co T1 *
%   5  1st Car''' = 1st Car'' − v6 = Δ1 = v2' = ar co. of ar Co of Δ² = Δ²
%   6  1st Car^iv = v2'' = 1st Car''' − v7' = Δ² − ar Co Δ1 = Δ² + Δ1 = Δ2;  2nd Car'' = 2nd Car' − v7' = − ArCo Δ1 = Δ1
%   7  1st Car^v = 0  2nd Car''' = 0  (then, faint, as if erased: 3rd Car ... v3 ... )
%   8  3rd Car'' = v3' = 2nd Car'' − v8' = Δ1 − ar Co T1 = Δ1 + T1 = T2 *
%   9  1st Car(7) − v1(5) = Ar Co. of Δ² = v6 = v7 = 1st Car   % "v1" written over another figure
%  10  1st Car(9) − v2(6) = ar Co of Δ² − Δ2 = ar Co. of (Δ² + Δ2) = ar Co. of Δ3 = v7;  2nd Car = ArCo v2(6) = ArCo Δ2
%  11  1st Car = 0  2nd = 0  3rd Carr = 2nd Car (10) = v8
%  12  3rd Car = v8 = 3rd carr(11) − v3(8) = Ar Co. Δ2 + Ar Co T2 = Ar. Co. of T3
%  13  1st Car = 1st Car(11) − v6(9) = − Ar co. of Δ² = Δ² = v1 = v2
%  14  1st Car = v2 = 1st Car(13) − v7(10) = Δ² − Ar Co of Δ3 = Δ4;  2nd Car = 2nd Car(11) − v7(10) = − ArCo. Δ3 = Δ3
%  15  1st Car = 2nd Car = 0  3rd Car = 2nd Car(14) = Δ3 = v3
%  16  3rd Car = v3 = 3rd Car(15) − v8(12) = Δ3 − Ar Co of T3 = Δ3 + T3 = T4 *


Remark "Carriages are negative"
Remark "1 In the first turn subtract Δ²0 from the first negative carriage reducing Δ²0 to zero also put the result upon the two axes v6 and v7. The result is the Arithmetical Complement of Δ²0"
Remark "2 Subtract Δ0 from arith comp of Δ²0 and put the result (which is the Arith Comp of {Δ²0 + Δ0 = Δ1}) under the arith comp of Δ²0 which is on carriage and also under the same in v7. Also subtract the Δ0 from another carriage the result is Arith Comp of Δ0 which put in the last named carriage reducing Δ0 to zero"
Remark "3 Reduce the two carriages to negative zero transfer the number on the second carriage to the figure wheels of the third carriage and also to v8"
Remark "4 Subtract T0 from the third carriage and from v8 the result is ar comp of T1 for the number on third carriage is that brought from the second in turn 2 which is Arith Comp of Δ0 wherefore in this turn the result is Arith Comp of Δ0 − T0 = Arith Comp of T1"
Remark "5 In this turn subtract v6 from the negative zero of the first carriage reducing v6 to zero and put the result [which is Ar Co of Ar Co of Δ² = Δ²] on this first carriage and also on v1 and v2 thus the result Δ² stands where it did at first"
Remark "6 Subtract v7 from Δ² on the first carriage and from Δ² on v2 and put the result (which is Δ² − Ar Co Δ1 = Δ² + Δ1 = Δ2) under Δ² on first carriage and on Δ² at v2 also subtract the same v7 from the second carr at neg zero the result which Ar Co of Ar Co of Δ1 = Δ1 put on the said Second carriage reducing Δ1 to zero"
Remark "7 Reduce first and second carriages to their neg zeros transferring the result on the second carriage to the fig. wheels of the third and also to v3 thus third carr and v3 have Δ1 upon them"
Remark "8 Subtract v8 from the third carriage and also from v3 and put the equal results on third carriage and on v3 which will then hold T2 for v3 − v8 = Δ1 − Ar Co of T1 = Δ1 + T1 = T2"
Remark "Now v1 has Δ² as before, v2 has Δ2 as before it had Δ0, v3 has T2 as before it had T0. The Machine stands now as at the beginning and the same process gives Ar.Co. of T2k+1 and T2k alternately"

No. 12

Title "Calculation of Pk = (Mk-1/Nk-1) Pk-1. M and N rational functions of the second degree"
Image 222/565 cover: "Calculation of Pk. Pk = (Mk-1/Nk-1)·Pk-1. M and N are rational functions of k of the second degree. Twelve Operations are required for each value of P. Two Great and Ten Small."
Image 222/566 the table
Image 222/567 back: "29 Aug 1837" in pencil, nothing else

% Store headings: v1 M0, v2 M0, v3 ΔM0, v4 Δ²M0, v5 M, v6 ΔM, v7 Δ²M,
% v8 P0, v9 N0, v10 N0, v11 ΔN0, v12 Δ²N0, v13 N, v14 ΔN, v15 Δ²N; v16 and
% v17 have no heading. A blank column stands between v4 and v5, between v7
% and v8, between v8 and v9, between v12 and v13.
% The store's carriages ("Car") step M and N, quadratics in k, by their
% differences, in letters; the mill does the two great operations of each
% cycle. A complement "C." is held as the negative it is on the wheels. The
% actions of each turn are read from the cells, by the rules of BAB/L/008
% to L/010 (a column read is subtracted from the carriages the row names;
% a carriage's number is laid in the columns it names; "−0" clears it): the
% sheet has no right-hand column. Mk, ΔMk, Nk, ΔNk are defined below from
% the sheet's M0, ΔM0, Δ²M (and N), and Pk by the cover's Pk = (Mk−1/Nk−1)Pk−1,
% so that every cell is checked against what the sheet's symbol means.
Letters M0 ΔM0 Δ²M N0 ΔN0 Δ²N P0
Let M1 = M0 + ΔM0
Let M2 = M0 + 2ΔM0 + Δ²M
Let M3 = M0 + 3ΔM0 + 3Δ²M
Let ΔM1 = ΔM0 + Δ²M
Let ΔM2 = ΔM0 + 2Δ²M
Let ΔM3 = ΔM0 + 3Δ²M
Let N1 = N0 + ΔN0
Let N2 = N0 + 2ΔN0 + Δ²N
Let N3 = N0 + 3ΔN0 + 3Δ²N
Let ΔN1 = ΔN0 + Δ²N
Let ΔN2 = ΔN0 + 2Δ²N
Let ΔN3 = ΔN0 + 3Δ²N
Let P1 = (M0/N0)·P0
Let P2 = (M1/N1)·P1

name: L015
title: BAB/L/015 No. 15, 23 Dec 1837
text:
% BAB/L/015, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001649.
% Cover 222/574 ("No 15", "23 Dec 1837"); the opened sheet with the table,
% 222/576; a pencil draft of a table in the same ruling, 222/573 (not
% transcribed); the back, 222/572. Read from the zoom images at full
% resolution. See sources/notes/L015.md.

Sheet BAB/L/015
No. 15
Date 23 Dec 1837          "No 15 23 Dec 1837"   % cover
Title "Notation for determining the value of x from the three equations ax + by + cz + ∂ = 0, a'x + b'y + c'z + ∂' = 0, a''x + b''y + c''z + ∂'' = 0 (A); First by reducing them to two equations of the form Hx + Ky + M = 0, H'x + K'y + M' = 0 (B); Secondly by reducing these two to one equivalent to H''x = M'' when x = M''/H''"
Image 222/574 cover: "Method of solution. The coeffecient of z in eqns 1, 2 of (A) are equalised, 2 & 3 ditto, Which gives the equations (B) by subtraction. In which equations (B) the coeffecients of y are equalised From which by subtraction arises the equation H''x = M''"
Image 222/576 the table
Image 222/573 a pencil draft in the same ruling, not transcribed
Image 222/572 back: pencil, faint, three lines, not read

% The sheet's ∂ (round d) is written d.
Letters a b c d a' b' c' d' a'' b'' c'' d''
Unknowns x y z
Equation a x + b y + c z + d = 0
Equation a' x + b' y + c' z + d' = 0
Equation a'' x + b'' y + c'' z + d'' = 0
Find x = M''/H''

% The store is headed by the three equations, v1-v4 "ax + by + cz + ∂",
% v5-v8 the second, v9-v12 the third; then the numbers of the operations
% repeated; then v13 to v19, unheaded.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = d, v5 = a', v6 = b', v7 = c', v8 = d', v9 = a'', v10 = b'', v11 = c'', v12 = d''
Working v13 v14 v15 v16 v17 v18 v19

% No right-hand column of formulas: each row is the operation, the mill's
% result and the cells. "Comp c'" and the like are written in words; here
% Cc'. H, K, M and their accents are the sheet's; =H marks where the sheet
% first writes each.
Op 1     ×  | c'a        | v1 0, v7 0, v13 Cc', v14 c'a |
Op 2     ×  | c'b        | v2 0, v15 c'b |
Op 3     ×  | c'd        | v4 c'd, v16 c'd |          % "c'd" in v4, in ink, and no 0: d is taken from v4 and the row writes no 0 there
Op 4     ×  | ca'        | v3 0, v5 0, v7 Ca', v17 ca' |
Op 5     ×  | cb'        | v2 cb', v5 Cb', v6 0 |
Op 6     ×  | cd'        | v6 Cd', v8 0, v18 cd' |
Op 7     −  | c'a-ca'    | v1 =H, v14 0, v17 0 |
Op 8     −  | c'b-cb'    | v2 0, v3 =K, v15 0 |        % also a fainter 0 in v14, with a smudge across it, as if erased; not written here
Op 9     −  | c'd-cd'    | v4 =M, v16 0, v18 0 |
Op 10       |            | v6 0, v8 d' |              % also a 0 in v5, smudged, as if erased; not written here
Op 11       |            | v5 0, v6 b' |
Op 12       |            | v5 a', v7 0 |
Op 13       |            | v7 c', v13 0 |
Op 14    ×  | c''a'      | v5 0, v11 0, v14 c''a' |
Op 15    ×  | c''b'      | v6 0, v15 c''b' |
Op 16    ×  | c''d'      | v8 0, v16 c''d' |
Op 17    ×  | c'a''      | v7 0, v9 0, v17 c'a'' |
Op 18    ×  | c'b''      | v10 0, v18 c'b'' |
Op 19    ×  | c'd''      | v12 0, v19 c'd'' |
Op 20    −  | c''a'-c'a'' | v5 =H', v14 0, v17 0 |
Op 21    −  | c''b'-c'b'' | v7 =K', v15 0, v18 0 |
Op 22    −  | c''d'-c'd'' | v8 =M', v16 0, v19 0 |
Op 23    ×  | HK'        | v1 0, v7 0, v9 HK' |
Op 24    ×  | MK'        | v4 0, v10 MK' |             % K' is in no column (v7 left at zero by 23): the common factor written second
Op 25    ×  | H'K        | v3 0, v5 0, v11 H'K |
Op 26    ×  | M'K        | v8 0, v12 M'K |             % K is in no column (v3 left at zero by 25): the common factor written second
Op 27    −  | HK'-H'K    | v1 =H'', v9 0, v11 0 |
Op 28    −  | M'K-MK'    | v4 =M'', v10 0, v12 0 |
Op 29    ÷  | M''/H''    | v5 =x |                     % no 0 written in v1 or v4

% Cover: "No of necessary variables = 12 / Contingent or working do = 7 /
% Total number of variables = 19".
States variables 12, working 7, occupied 19

Unrun "pencil, faint, right of the table: a column of formulas in the variables, e.g. 'v7 v1 = v13', 'v3 v6 = v2'', 'v3 v8 = v17', 'v14 - v16 = v1'', which do not all match the ink table's columns; not read in full"

name: L016-1
title: BAB/L/016/1 No. 16, Jun 1838
text:
% BAB/L/016/1, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001657
% ("Sheet 1"), with the list of formulas on BAB/L/016/2 (aa110001662, image
% 222/581). Cover 222/578 "No 16 Sheet 1 June 1838", in pencil "see also
% Sheet 2"; the table 222/579, "June 1838" in pencil at its top right; the
% back 222/580, "G.R signifies give off & retain", "June 1838". Read from the
% zoom images at full resolution. See sources/notes/L016.md.
%
% DRAFT (.bab.draft): the engine does not read "G.R". A column marked G.R
% gives its number to the mill and keeps it ("give off & retain"): the
% first sheet of the series to write it. Everything else here is in the
% notation as it stands.

Sheet BAB/L/016/1
No. 16
Date Jun 1838            "No 16 Sheet 1 June 1838"   % cover
Title "Reduction of the equations ax + by + cz + d = 0, a'x + b'y + c'z + d' = 0, a''x + b''y + c''z + d'' = 0 to three others Ax + By + Cz + D = 0, A'x + B'y + C'z + D' = 0, A''x + B''y + C''z + D'' = 0 = By + Ax + Cz + D wherein A = 0, A' = 0, A'' = 0, which in like manner are reduced to βy + αx + γz + δ = 0, β'y + α'x + γ'z + δ' = 0, β''y + α''x + γ''z + δ'' = 0 wherein β = 0 α = 0"
Image 222/578 cover: "Notation of the reduction of the three equations (1) ax + by + cz + d = 0 (2) a'x + b'y + c'z + d' = 0 (3) a''x + b''y + c''z + d'' = 0 (a) to three others of the same form as (1) Ax + By + Cz + D = 0 ... in which A = 0, A' = 0, A'' = 0 (b), and the reduction of these last three equations into three others viz (1) βy + αx + γz + δ = 0 ... (c) in which β = 0, α = 0, β' = ..."; then "Method of Operating"
Image 222/579 the table, two sets of operations
Image 222/580 back: "G.R signifies give off & retain"
Image 222/581 (Sheet 2) in pencil: "This is the Composition of the transformation of the equations given in Notation No 1 above" (the formulas below)

% The sheet writes the coefficient of z's partner as the round-backed ∂;
% here d. Its accents stand before the letter ('a, "b); here after.
Letters a b c d a' b' c' d' a'' b'' c'' d''
Unknowns x y z
Equation a x + b y + c z + d = 0
Equation a' x + b' y + c' z + d' = 0
Equation a'' x + b'' y + c'' z + d'' = 0
Find A = 0
Find A' = 0
Find A'' = 0

% The store as the table heads it: v1 to v4 a b c ∂, v5 to v8 'a 'b 'c '∂,
% v9 to v12 "a "b "c "∂. v13 to v36 are working variables, headed only by
% the letters of the equations above them.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = d, v5 = a', v6 = b', v7 = c', v8 = d', v9 = a'', v10 = b'', v11 = c'', v12 = d''
Working v13 v14 v15 v16 v17 v18 v19 v20 v21 v22 v23 v24 v25 v26 v27 v28 v29 v30 v31 v32 v33 v34 v35 v36

% The table has no species of operation: each row is its number, the
% product or difference "in the mill" (the column left of v1), and the
% cells. The species are supplied here: rows 1-21 multiply, 22-33
% subtract. The right-hand field is the pencil list on Sheet 2, which
% writes the multiplicand first (v13 = v1 v5: the table of a) where the
% mill column writes it second (a'a); and writes accents before the v
% ('v2 = v13 − v14 = 0 = A); here after. Rows 22-33's mill column is
% Bezout's notation, as the foot of the sheet says: "(a'a'') was written
% instead of a'a'' − a''a' &c after the manner of Bezout".
Op 1   ×  | a'a      | v1 0, v5 G.R, v13 a'a, v14 aa'         | v13 = v1·v5 = v14   % the mill and v13 write a'a, v14 aa'; the list writes v13 = v14 = v1 v5
Op 2   ×  | b'a      | v6 G.R, v15 b'a                        | v15 = v1·v6
Op 3   ×  | c'a      | v7 G.R, v16 c'a                        | v16 = v1·v7
Op 4   ×  | d'a      | v8 G.R, v17 d'a                        | v17 = v1·v8
Op 5   ×  | a''a     | v9 G.R, v18 a''a, v19 aa''             | v18 = v1·v9 = v19   % v19 written aa''; beside the list, fainter: '= v4 = v9 v1'
Op 6   ×  | b''a     | v10 G.R, v20 b''a                      | v20 = v1·v10
Op 7   ×  | c''a     | v11 G.R, v21 c''a                      | v21 = v1·v11
Op 8   ×  | d''a     | v12 G.R, v22 d''a                      | v22 = v1·v12
Op 9   ×  | ba'      | v2 G.R, v5 0, v23 ba'                  | v23 = v5·v2
Op 10  ×  | ca'      | v3 G.R, v24 ca'                        | v24 = v5·v3
Op 11  ×  | da'      | v4 G.R, v25 da'                        | v25 = v5·v4
Op 12  ×  | a''a'    | v9 G.R, v26 a''a', v27 a'a''           | v26 = v5·v9 = v27
Op 13  ×  | b''a'    | v10 0, v28 b''a'                       | v28 = v5·v10   % a smudge, as of something rubbed out, left of v28
Op 14  ×  | c''a'    | v11 0, v29 c''a'                       | v29 = v5·v11   % v29 written '-c''a''' with a smudge before it
Op 15  ×  | d''a'    | v12 0, v30 d''a'                       | v30 = v5·v12
Op 16  ×  | ba''     | v2 0, v9 0, v31 ba''                   | v31 = v9·v2
Op 17  ×  | ca''     | v3 0, v32 ca''                         | v32 = v9·v3
Op 18  ×  | da''     | v4 0, v33 da''                         | v33 = v9·v4
Op 19  ×  | b'a''    | v6 0, v34 b'a''                        | v34 = v9·v6
Op 20  ×  | c'a''    | v7 0, v35 c'a''                        | v35 = v9·v7
Op 21  ×  | d'a''    | v8 0, v36 d'a''                        | v36 = v9·v8
Op 22  −  | a'a-aa'      | v13 0, v14 0, v2 =A        | A = v2' = v13-v14 = 0   % the mill column writes (a'a); v2 written 'A=0'
Op 23  −  | b'a-ba'      | v15 0, v23 0, v1 =B        | B = v1' = v15-v23   % the mill column writes (b'a)
Op 24  −  | c'a-ca'      | v16 0, v24 0, v3 =C        | C = v3' = v16-v24   % the mill column writes (c'a)
Op 25  −  | d'a-da'      | v17 0, v25 0, v4 =D        | D = v4' = v17-v25   % the mill column writes (d'a)
Op 26  −  | a''a-aa''    | v18 0, v19 0, v6 =A'       | A' = v6' = v18-v19 = 0   % the mill column writes (a''a); v6 written "A'=0"
Op 27  −  | b''a-ba''    | v20 0, v31 0, v5 =B'       | B' = v5' = v20-v31   % the mill column writes (b''a)
Op 28  −  | c''a-ca''    | v21 0, v32 0, v7 =C'       | C' = v7' = v21-v32   % the mill column writes (c''a)
Op 29  −  | d''a-da''    | v22 0, v33 0, v8 =D'       | D' = v8' = v22-v33   % the mill column writes (d''a)
Op 30  −  | a''a'-a'a''  | v26 0, v27 0, v10 =A''     | A'' = v10' = v26-v27 = 0   % the mill column writes (a''a'); v10 written "A''=0"; in the list the 10 of 'v10 is written over another figure
Op 31  −  | b''a'-b'a''  | v28 0, v34 0, v9 =B''      | B'' = v9' = v28-v34   % the mill column writes (b''a')
Op 32  −  | c''a'-c'a''  | v29 0, v35 0, v11 =C''     | C'' = v11' = v29-v35   % the mill column writes (c''a')
Op 33  −  | d''a'-d'a''  | v30 0, v36 0, v12 =D''     | D'' = v12' = v30-v36   % the mill column writes (d''a')

% "repetition of the same process": a second set, headed B A C D | B' A' C'
% D' | B'' A'' C'' D'' over v1 to v12, written in part only:
%   1   BB' (mill "B'B" with the B' struck through?)  v1 0, v5 G.R, v13 B'B, v14 BB'
%   ... 21  v1 to v12 all 0; v13 B'B, v14 BB', v15 A'B, v16 C'B, v17 D'B,
%           v18 B''B, v19 BB'', v20 A''B, v21 C''B, v22 D''B, v23 AB', v24 CB',
%           v25 DB', v26 B''B', v27 B'B'', v28 A''B', v29 C''B', v30 D''B',
%           v31 AB'', v32 CB'', v33 DA'' (sic: by the pattern DB''), v34 A'B'',
%           v35 C'B'', v36 D'B''
%   22 (B'B)  v13 0, v14 0, v1 "β=0"
%   23 (A'B)  v15 0, v23 0, v2 "α=0"
%   24 (C'B)  v16 0, v24 0, v3 γ
%   25 (D'B)  v17 0, v25 0, v4 δ
%   ... 33    v5 "β'=0", v6 "α'=0", v7 γ', v8 δ', v9 "β''=0", v10 "α''=0",
%             v11 γ'', v12 δ''; v13 to v36 all 0
% It is the first set with B for a, A for b, C for c and D for d.
Remark "Here No 21 in the second set of operations shews the actual state of the engine at that instant which will be seen to be exactly similar to No 21 set 1 the preceding and succeeding operations are also alike in the two sets comparing the same numbers together"
Remark "(a'a'') was written instead of a'a'' - a''a' &c after the manner of Bezout"
Unrun "the second set of operations, written in part (rows 1, 21, 22-25, 33): in comments above"
Unrun "the cover's 'Method of Operating', twice begun and struck through ('wrong'), then: the equations (2) & (3) of (a) are multiplied by a the coefficient of the first variable in eqn (1); eqn (1) & (3) by a'; eqn (1) & (2) by a''; these six equations subtracted in pairs give (b); the same process on (b) gives (c)"
Unrun "222/581, beside the list in pencil: (ad + ...)/(a + b...), a(b + c), (ab + ac)/r = a(b + c)/r, ab/r + ac/r"

name: L016-2
title: BAB/L/016/2 No. 16, Jun 1838
text:
% BAB/L/016/2, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001662
% ("Sheet 2"). Three images: 222/581, the front, in pencil, "No 16" and the
% list of formulas for Sheet 1's first set (transcribed as the right-hand
% column of corpus/L016-1.bab.draft); 222/582, the opened sheet, in ink,
% "June 1838"; 222/583, the back, "June 1838" in pencil. Read from the zoom
% images at full resolution. See sources/notes/L016.md.
%
% The opened sheet has no table of operations. Its right half describes, in
% words and equations, what Sheet 1's two sets of operations do; its left
% half sketches the same for five equations in five variables. Nothing on
% it is a row the engine can run: the page states the equations and quotes
% the sheet.

Sheet BAB/L/016/2
No. 16
Date Jun 1838            "June 1838"   % top right of 222/582
Title "Successive reduction of simultaneous equations: three equations in three variables, and five in five"
Image 222/581 front: pencil list "This is the Composition of the transformation of the equations given in Notation No 1 above"
Image 222/582 the opened sheet: the reduction described in words
Image 222/583 back: "June 1838"

Letters a b c d a' b' c' d' a'' b'' c'' d''
Unknowns x y z
Equation a x + b y + c z + d = 0
Equation a' x + b' y + c' z + d' = 0
Equation a'' x + b'' y + c'' z + d'' = 0

Remark "1 ax + by + cz + d = 0 2 a'x + b'y + c'z + d' = 0 3 a''x + b''y + c''z + d'' = 0. Multiply 2 & 3 by a the coeffecient of x in 1, 1 & 3 by a' ... 2, 1 & 2 by a'' ... 3. Hence arises six equations which being properly disposed (1) f + d'a = 0 (2) f + d''a (3) f + da' (4) f + d''a' (5) f + da'' 6 f + d'a = 0. Then (1) - (3) = {1}, (2) - (5) = {2}, (3) - (6) = {3}"
Remark "{1} (a'a - aa')x + (b'a - ba')y + (c'a - ca')z + (d'a - da') = 0 {2} (a''a - aa'')x + (b''a - ba'')y + (c''a - ca'')z + (d''a - da'') = 0 {3} (a''a' - a'a'')x + (b''a' - b'a'')y + (c''a' - c'a'')z + (d''a' - d'a'') = 0"
Remark "Thus the machine has transformed the three given equations into three others of the same form but the coeffecient of the first variable in each is equal to nothing. The action of the machine has therefore changed the coeffecients of the first variable to zero in the resulting equations; these equations may be written Ax + By + Cz + D = 0, A'x + B'y + C'z + D' = 0, A''x + B''y + C''z + D'' = 0 where A = 0 A' = 0 A'' = 0"
Remark "If the same equations By + Ax + Cz + D = 0 ... be placed in the machine and subjected to the same operations as their primitives their derivatives βy + αx + γz + δ = 0, β'y + α'x + γ'z + δ' = 0, β''y + α''x + γ''z + δ'' = 0 will be found by repeating the same mechanical actions bringing about the same processes and conclusion i.e. it reduces the coeffecient of the first variable (which now is y) to zero i.e. β = 0 β' = 0 β'' = 0 α, α' & α'' are each zero per se hence these three equations are in fact γz + δ = 0, γ'z + δ' = 0, γ''z + δ'' = 0 and δ/γ = δ'/γ' = δ''/γ'' = -z"
Remark "Primitive equation f(x, y, z, u, v, a) = 0, f(x, y, z, u, v, a') = 0, ... f(x, y, z, u, v, a'''') = 0 put in the Machine; Machine puts out f1(0x, y, z, u, v, a) = 0 ...; put in the Machine f1(y, 0x, z, u, v, a) = 0 ...; Machine puts out ...; ... Machine puts out f(0, ..., v, a) = 0 ... from either of which v may be determined"
Unrun "222/582, left half: the five-variable sketch, each block of five functions between 'put in the Machine' and 'Machine puts out', the zeroed variables written 0x, 0y, ...; the inner lines are partly illegible and were not read cell for cell"
Unrun "222/581: beside the list, pencil working: (ad + ...)/(a + b...), a(b + c), (ab + ac)/r = a(b + c)/r, -ab/r + ac/r"

name: L017
title: BAB/L/017 No. 17, 1 Oct 1838
text:
% BAB/L/017, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001665.
% Cover 222/584 ("No 17", "1 Oct. 1838": the day is written small and could be
% read 4; BAB/L/018 is "Copied from Not. No 17 Dated 1 Oct. 1838"); the opened
% sheet 222/585 with the table and, at the right, its composition of the
% results; the back 340/289, blank. Read from the zoom images; the table
% from tiles fetched at full size and reduced by about a tenth (the image
% service then refused further requests). See sources/notes/L017.md.

Sheet BAB/L/017
No. 17
Date 1 Oct 1838          "No 17 1 Oct. 1838"   % cover
Title "Notation For computing the elliptic radius vector by having the eccentricity and mean anomaly"
Image 222/584 cover: the formula, the coefficients P and Q and their differences, and "Let n = 6 p = 0"
Image 222/585 the table (Mill, Store) and its right-hand column
Image 340/289 back, blank

% The cover's formula: ρ = A0 + A1 cos E + A2 cos 2E + &c + An cos nE + &c;
% An = Bn,n·ε^n + Bn,n+2·ε^(n+2) + &c + Bn,n+2p·ε^(n+2p) + Bn,n+2p+2·ε^(n+2p+2) + &c;
% A0 = a(1 + ½ε²); Bn,n = −n^(n−2)/(1·2·3…(n−1)·2^(n−1))·a;
% Bn+1,n+1 = (n+1)^(n−1)/(1·2·3…n·2^n)·a = ½((n+1)/n)^(n−1)·Bn,n;
% Bn,n+2p = −(−1)^p (n+2p)(n+2p−1)…(n+p+1) × n^(n−2+2p) / ((n−1+2p) × 1·2·3…p × 2^(n−1+2p))·a
%   (as far as read);
% Bn,n+2p+2 = −(n²/4)·(n+2+2p)/((1+p)(1+n+p)(n+2p))·Bn,n+2p = −(Pp/4Qp)·Bn,n+2p
%   (the 4 before Qp partly a pencil stroke);
% Pp = n²(n+2+2p), ΔPp = 2n², Δ² = 0;
% Qp = 4(1+p)(1+n+p)(n+2p), with ΔQp, Δ²Qp and Δ³Qp worked out below it.
% Then: "Let n = 6 p = 0  Pp = 288 ΔP = 72  Q0 = 168 ΔQ0 = 344 Δ²Q0 = 224
% Δ³Q0 = 48" (the last figure could be read 45; the cover's working above
% it ends "= 48").
%
% So the table computes B6,8, B6,10, … B6,18 from B6,6 by that recurrence,
% stepping P and Q by their differences in the mill (all its small
% operations are additions). The numbers P0 … Δ³Q are the cover's; the
% names P1 … Q5 are what the sheet's symbols mean, by the differences.
Letters B66
Let P0 = 288
Let ΔP = 72
Let Q0 = 168
Let ΔQ0 = 344
Let Δ²Q0 = 224
Let Δ³Q = 48
Let P1 = P0 + ΔP
Let P2 = P1 + ΔP
Let P3 = P2 + ΔP
Let P4 = P3 + ΔP
Let P5 = P4 + ΔP
Let Δ²Q1 = Δ²Q0 + Δ³Q
Let Δ²Q2 = Δ²Q1 + Δ³Q
Let Δ²Q3 = Δ²Q2 + Δ³Q
Let ΔQ1 = ΔQ0 + Δ²Q0
Let ΔQ2 = ΔQ1 + Δ²Q1
Let ΔQ3 = ΔQ2 + Δ²Q2
Let ΔQ4 = ΔQ3 + Δ²Q3
Let Q1 = Q0 + ΔQ0
Let Q2 = Q1 + ΔQ1
Let Q3 = Q2 + ΔQ2
Let Q4 = Q3 + ΔQ3
Let Q5 = Q4 + ΔQ4

% The store as the table starts it: v1 P0, v2 P0, v3 ΔP, v4 ΔP, v6 Q0,
% v8 ΔQ0, v10 Δ²Q0, v12 Δ³Q, v16 B6,6; v7, v9, v11 and v13 are written 0.
% v5 is headed and never used.
Store v1 = P0, v2 = P0, v3 = ΔP, v4 = ΔP, v6 = Q0, v8 = ΔQ0, v10 = Δ²Q0, v12 = Δ³Q, v16 = B66
Working v7 v9 v11 v13 v14 v15 v17 v18 v19 v20 v21 v22

% Columns: "No of Oper", a column with a star between each multiplication
% and the row after it (put here on the multiplication), "Nature of Opern",
% the mill's result; then the store. The results of the additions are
% written in braces, {P1}, {Q1}; the braces are left out here. Each
% addition and division gives one of the numbers it reads back to another
% column, as it is (v9 ΔQ0 at operation 4; v2 P1 and v6 Q1 at 5; ...):
% Rojas's "give off and retain". The B's alternate between v15 and v17 as
% the next multiplicand, and each is kept once more, in v16, v18 ... v22.
% Two columns are taken as v16: a narrow one headed "V16" holding B6,6,
% and the one beside it, headed "v1" and a 5 or 6 written over, that
% receives B6,8; the right-hand column calls B6,8 "v16".
Op 1     ÷  | P0/Q0          | v1 0, v6 0, v14 P0/Q0 |                     % Q0 is read from v6 and given back nowhere (v7 stays 0); operation 4 reads v6 again. BAB/L/018's copy gives Q0 to a second column here
Op 2   * ×  | (P0/Q0)·B66    | v14 0, v15 =B68, v16 0, v16 B68 |
Op 3     +  | P0+ΔP          | v1 P1, v2 0, v3 0 |
Op 4     +  | Q0+ΔQ0         | v6 0, v7 Q1, v8 0, v9 ΔQ0 |
Op 5     ÷  | P1/Q1          | v1 0, v2 P1, v6 Q1, v7 0, v14 P1/Q1 |
Op 6   * ×  | (P1/Q1)·B68    | v14 0, v15 0, v17 =B610, v18 B610 |
Op 7     +  | P1+ΔP          | v1 P2, v2 0, v3 ΔP, v4 0 |
Op 8     +  | Δ²Q0+ΔQ0       | v8 ΔQ1, v9 0, v10 0, v11 Δ²Q0 |            % the mill's second subscript is not clear; read as 0
Op 9     +  | Q1+ΔQ1         | v6 0, v7 Q2, v8 0, v9 ΔQ1 |
Op 10    ÷  | P2/Q2          | v1 0, v2 P2, v6 Q2, v7 0, v14 P2/Q2 |
Op 11  * ×  | (P2/Q2)·B610   | v14 0, v15 =B612, v17 0, v19 B612 |
Op 12    +  | P2+ΔP          | v1 P3, v2 0, v3 0, v4 ΔP |
Op 13    +  | Δ²Q0+Δ³Q       | v10 Δ²Q1, v11 0, v12 0, v13 Δ³Q |
Op 14    +  | ΔQ1+Δ²Q1       | v8 ΔQ2, v9 0, v10 0, v11 Δ²Q1 |
Op 15    +  | Q2+ΔQ2         | v6 0, v7 Q3, v8 0, v9 ΔQ2 |
Op 16    ÷  | P3/Q3          | v1 0, v2 P3, v6 Q3, v7 0, v14 P3/Q3 |      % v6's Q3 has a brace on one side
Op 17  * ×  | (P3/Q3)·B612   | v14 0, v15 0, v17 =B614, v20 B614 |
Op 18    +  | P3+ΔP          | v1 P4, v2 0, v3 ΔP, v4 0 |
Op 19    +  | Δ²Q1+Δ³Q       | v10 Δ²Q2, v11 0, v12 Δ³Q, v13 0 |
Op 20    +  | ΔQ2+Δ²Q2       | v8 ΔQ3, v9 0, v10 0, v11 Δ²Q2 |
Op 21    +  | Q3+ΔQ3         | v6 0, v7 Q4, v8 0, v9 ΔQ3 |
Op 22    ÷  | P4/Q4          | v1 0, v2 P4, v6 Q4, v7 0, v14 P4/Q4 |
Op 23  * ×  | (P4/Q4)·B614   | v14 0, v15 =B616, v17 0, v21 B616 |
Op 24    +  | P4+ΔP          | v1 P5, v2 0, v3 0, v4 ΔP |
Op 25    +  | Δ²Q2+Δ³Q       | v10 Δ²Q3, v11 0, v12 0, v13 Δ³Q |          % faint pencil "4 4 4" left of the number
Op 26    +  | ΔQ3+Δ²Q3       | v8 ΔQ4, v9 0, v10 0, v11 Δ²Q3 |
Op 27    +  | Q4+ΔQ4         | v6 0, v7 Q5, v8 0, v9 ΔQ4 |
Op 28    ÷  | P5/Q5          | v1 0, v2 P5, v6 Q5, v7 0, v14 P5/Q5 |
Op 29  * ×  | (P5/Q5)·B616   | v14 0, v15 0, v17 =B618, v22 B618 |

% The right-hand column. Accents are written before the variable ('v1 is v1′).
% "v16 = (v1/v6)·v16 = (P0/Q0)·B6,6 = (288/168)·B6,6 = (12/7)·B6,6 = B6,8":
Composition v16 = (v1/v6)·v16 = (P0/Q0)·B66 = (288/168)·B66 = (12/7)·B66 = B68
% "v18 = ('v1/'v6)·v16 = (P1/Q1)·v16 = ((v2 + v3)/(v6 + v8))·v1 = ((P0 + ΔP)/(Q0 + ΔQ0))·(P0/Q0)·B6,6
% = ((288 + 72)/(168 + 344))·(12/7)·B6,6 = (360/512)·(12/7)·B6,6 = (1080/896)·B6,6 = (135/112)·B6,6 = B6,10";
% the member ((v2 + v3)/(v6 + v8))·v1 is left out: its last letter is uncertain.
Composition v18 = (v1'/v6')·v16 = (P1/Q1)·v16 = ((P0+ΔP)/(Q0+ΔQ0))·(P0/Q0)·B66 = ((288+72)/(168+344))·(12/7)·B66 = (360/512)·(12/7)·B66 = (1080/896)·B66 = (135/112)·B66 = B610
% "v20 = ''v14·v17 = (''v1/'v7)·v17 = (('v2 + v4)/('v6 + 'v8))·v17 = (('v1 + v4)/(v7 + 'v8))·v17
% = ((v2 + v3 + v4)/(v6 + v8 + 'v9 + v10))·v17 = ((P0 + ΔP + ΔP)/(Q0 + ΔQ0 + ΔQ0 + Δ²Q0))·v18
% = ((P0 + 2ΔP)/(Q0 + 2ΔQ0 + Δ²Q0))·((P0 + ΔP)/(Q0 + ΔQ0))·(P0/Q0)·B6,6
% = ((288 + 2×72)/(168 + 2×344 + 224))·(135/112)·B6,6 = ((288 + 144)/(168 + 688 + 224))·(135/112)·B6,6
% = (432/1080)·(135/112)·B6,6 = (54/112)·B6,6 = (27/56)·B6,6 = B6,12"
Composition v20 = v14''·v17 = (v1''/v7')·v17 = ((v2'+v4)/(v6'+v8'))·v17 = ((v1'+v4)/(v7+v8'))·v17 = ((v2+v3+v4)/(v6+v8+v9'+v10))·v17 = ((P0+ΔP+ΔP)/(Q0+ΔQ0+ΔQ0+Δ²Q0))·v18 = ((P0+2·ΔP)/(Q0+2·ΔQ0+Δ²Q0))·((P0+ΔP)/(Q0+ΔQ0))·(P0/Q0)·B66 = ((288+2·72)/(168+2·344+224))·(135/112)·B66 = ((288+144)/(168+688+224))·(135/112)·B66 = (432/1080)·(135/112)·B66 = (54/112)·B66 = (27/56)·B66 = B612

% The cover's statements, with n = 6: Pp = n²(n+2+2p) and ΔP = 2n² against
% its P0 = 288 and ΔP = 72, and against the P5 the table reaches by
% differences; Qp = 4(1+p)(1+n+p)(n+2p) against Q0 = 168 and its
% differences, and against Q5.
Composition P0 = 6·6·(6+2)
Composition ΔP = 2·6·6
Composition P5 = 6·6·(6+2+2·5)
Composition Q0 = 4·1·7·6
Composition ΔQ0 = 4·2·8·8 - 4·1·7·6
Composition Δ²Q0 = 4·3·9·10 - 2·4·2·8·8 + 4·1·7·6
Composition Δ³Q = 4·4·10·12 - 3·4·3·9·10 + 3·4·2·8·8 - 4·1·7·6
Composition Q5 = 4·6·12·16
% The recurrence as the cover states it, Bn,n+2p+2 = −(n²/4)(n+2+2p)/((1+p)(1+n+p)(n+2p))·Bn,n+2p,
% at n = 6, p = 0, against the B6,8 the table makes.
Composition B68 = -(6·6/4)·((6+2)/(1·7·6))·B66

Unrun "cover, beside the B formulas, in pencil: 'n = 6 p = 0 / p = 1' and 'B6,6' and small figures; in the left margin lower down, small figures (perhaps 192, 56, 248, ...)"
Unrun "pencil figures beside many cells of v6 to v13 (2, 3, 4: the index of the number in the cell), and '4 4 4' left of operation 25"
Unrun "arrows from the right-hand column's v16, v18, v20 towards the table; curved pencil lines from the B cells of operations 2, 6 and 11 to the right"
Unrun "lower right of the opened sheet: a long working in small writing, products of fractions continuing the composition for the later B; not transcribed"

name: L018
title: BAB/L/018 No. 18, 9 Aug 1841
text:
% BAB/L/018, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001666.
% Cover (222/586): "No 18 Copied from Not. No 17 Dated 1 Oct. 1838", and
% "9 Aug. 1841" under the title. The opened sheet (222/587) holds the table
% of 29 operations, and to its right a long "Computation of B6,..." in the
% variables (not transcribed). The back (222/588): a date at the top left,
% "1 Oct 183[8 or 9]", read only in overview. Read from the zoom images at
% full resolution, except the right-hand computation and the back, which the
% image service refused to serve again (403) and are read in overview only.
% See sources/notes/L018.md.

Sheet BAB/L/018
No. 18
Date 9 Aug 1841          "9 Aug. 1841"   % cover; "Copied from Not. No 17 Dated 1 Oct. 1838"
Title "Notation For Computing the Elliptic radius vector by having the eccentricity ε & mean Anomaly Ξ"
Image 222/586 cover: the formula ρ = A0 + A1 cos Ξ + A2 cos 2Ξ + ... + An cos nΞ + &c; An = Bn,n εⁿ + Bn,n+2 εⁿ⁺² + &c + Bn,n+2p εⁿ⁺²ᵖ + &c; A0 = a(1 + ε²/2); the Bs; Pp, Qp and their differences; "Let n = 6, p = 0, P0 = 288, Q0 = 168, ΔP = 72, ΔQ0 = 344, Δ²Q0 = 224, Δ³Q0 = 48"; B6,6 = −27a/80
Image 222/587 the table, and the computation of B6,... to its right
Image 222/588 back

% From the cover, for n = 6:
%   Bn,n+2p+2 = −(n²(n+2+2p) / 4(1+p)(1+n+p)(n+2p)) Bn,n+2p = −(Pp/Qp) Bn,n+2p
%   Pp = n²(n+2+2p);  ΔP = 2n²;  Δ²P = 0
%   Qp = 4(1+p)(1+n+p)(n+2p);  ΔQp = 24p² + 8(7+3n)p + 4(8+7n+n²);
%   Δ²Qp = 48p + 8(10+3n);  Δ³Qp = 48;  Δ⁴Qp = 0
% The table writes B6,6, B6,8, ... without their signs: beside the table,
% "B6,6 has a −", then "B6,8 .. +", "B6,10 .... −", "B6,12 ... +",
% "B6,14 ...... −", "B6,16 ..... +", "B6,18 has a sign −". So the columns
% hold the Bs as numbers without sign, here B66, B68, ...: the cover's
% Bn,n+2p for n = 6 and p = 0 to 6, without its sign (worked out here from
% the cover's general formula, so that each cell is checked against it, not
% against the recurrence the table runs). Pp, Qp and their differences are
% the cover's formulas at n = 6.
Letters a
Let P0 = 6·6·(6+2)
Let P1 = 6·6·(6+2+2)
Let P2 = 6·6·(6+2+4)
Let P3 = 6·6·(6+2+6)
Let P4 = 6·6·(6+2+8)
Let P5 = 6·6·(6+2+10)
Let ΔP = 2·6·6
Let Q0 = 4·1·7·6
Let Q1 = 4·2·8·8
Let Q2 = 4·3·9·10
Let Q3 = 4·4·10·12
Let Q4 = 4·5·11·14
Let Q5 = 4·6·12·16
Let ΔQ0 = 4·(8+7·6+6·6)
Let ΔQ1 = 24 + 8·(7+18) + 4·(8+42+36)
Let ΔQ2 = 24·4 + 8·(7+18)·2 + 4·(8+42+36)
Let ΔQ3 = 24·9 + 8·(7+18)·3 + 4·(8+42+36)
Let ΔQ4 = 24·16 + 8·(7+18)·4 + 4·(8+42+36)
Let Δ²Q0 = 8·(10+18)
Let Δ²Q1 = 48 + 8·(10+18)
Let Δ²Q2 = 48·2 + 8·(10+18)
Let Δ²Q3 = 48·3 + 8·(10+18)
Let Δ³Q = 48
Let B66 = 27a/80            % the cover: B6,6 = −6⁴/(1·2·3·4·5·2⁵)a = −2⁴3⁴a/(2⁸·3·5) = −3³a/(2⁴5) = −27a/80
Let B68 = 81a/140
Let B610 = 729a/1792
Let B612 = 729a/4480
Let B614 = 2187a/51200
Let B616 = 19683a/2464000
Let B618 = 177147a/157696000

% The store as the table starts it. Above v1, v3, v5, v7, v9, v11 the sheet
% writes the numbers in braces: {288}, {72}, {168}, {344}, {224}, {48}.
% v6, v8, v10, v12 are written 0. A column between v12 and v13 is headed
% "v12" with a cross above (here v22); it holds B6,6 and is not used again.
Store v1 = P0, v2 = P0, v3 = ΔP, v4 = ΔP, v5 = Q0, v7 = ΔQ0, v9 = Δ²Q0, v11 = Δ³Q, v22 = B66, v13 = B66
Working v6 v8 v10 v12 v14 v15 v16 v17 v18 v19 v20 v21

% No right-hand column of formulas. Numbers in braces in the store, {P1},
% {Q1}, {ΔQ1}, {Δ²Q1} ..., are written here without them: each is the sum
% the row makes. A star stands left of each multiplication that makes a B.
% Rows where the sheet writes a number read in that row again in another
% column (Q0 in v6 at row 1, ΔQ0 in v8 at row 4, P1 in v2 at row 5, ΔP in
% v3 at row 7, ...) are written as the sheet writes them.
Op 1     ÷  | P0/Q0          | v1 0, v5 0, v6 Q0, v14 P0/Q0 |
Op 2  *  ×  | (P0/Q0)·B66    | v13 0, v14 0, v15 B68, v16 B68 |
Op 3     +  | P0+ΔP          | v1 P1, v2 0, v3 0 |
Op 4     +  | Q0+ΔQ0         | v5 Q1, v6 0, v7 0, v8 ΔQ0 |
Op 5     ×  | P1/Q1          | v1 0, v2 P1, v5 0, v6 Q1, v14 P1/Q1 |      % the species is ×, in ink; the mill column a quotient
Op 6  *  ÷  | (P1/Q1)·B68    | v13 B610, v14 0, v16 0, v17 B610 |       % the species is ÷, in ink, over a faint pencil mark; the mill column a product
Op 7     +  | P1+ΔP          | v1 P2, v2 0, v3 ΔP, v4 0 |
Op 8     +  | ΔQ0+Δ²Q0       | v7 ΔQ1, v8 0, v9 0, v10 Δ²Q0 |
Op 9     +  | Q1+ΔQ1         | v5 Q2, v6 0, v7 0, v8 ΔQ1 |
Op 10    ÷  | P2/Q2          | v1 0, v2 P2, v5 0, v6 Q2, v14 P2/Q2 |   % a faint 0 in the unheaded column before v1
Op 11 *  ×  | (P2/Q2)·B610   | v14 0, v16 B612, v17 0, v18 B612 |
Op 12    +  | P2+ΔP          | v1 P3, v2 0, v3 0, v4 ΔP |
Op 13    +  | Δ²Q0+Δ³Q       | v9 Δ²Q1, v10 0, v11 0, v12 Δ³Q |
Op 14    +  | ΔQ1+Δ²Q1       | v7 ΔQ2, v8 0, v9 0, v10 Δ²Q1 |
Op 15    +  | Q2+ΔQ2         | v5 Q3, v6 0, v7 0, v8 ΔQ2 |
Op 16    ÷  | P3/Q3          | v1 0, v2 P3, v5 0, v6 Q3, v14 P3/Q3 |
Op 17 *  ×  | (P3/Q3)·B612   | v14 0, v17 B614, v18 0, v19 B614 |
Op 18    +  | P3+ΔP          | v1 P4, v2 0, v3 ΔP, v4 0 |
Op 19    +  | Δ²Q1+Δ³Q       | v9 Δ²Q2, v10 0, v11 Δ³Q, v12 0 |
Op 20    +  | ΔQ2+ΔQ2        | v7 ΔQ3, v8 0, v9 0, v10 Δ²Q2 |        % so written: "ΔQ2 + ΔQ2", read again at full size
Op 21    +  | Q3+ΔQ3         | v5 Q4, v6 0, v7 0, v8 ΔQ3 |
Op 22    ÷  | P4/Q4          | v1 0, v2 P4, v5 0, v6 Q4, v14 P4/Q4 |
Op 23 *  ×  | (P4/Q4)·B614   | v14 0, v18 B616, v19 0, v20 B616 |
Op 24    +  | P4+ΔP          | v1 P5, v2 0, v3 0, v4 ΔP |
Op 25    +  | Δ²Q2+Δ³Q       | v9 Δ²Q3, v10 0, v11 0, v12 Δ³Q |
Op 26    +  | ΔQ3+Δ²Q3       | v7 ΔQ4, v8 0, v9 0, v10 Δ²Q3 |
Op 27    +  | Q4+ΔQ4         | v5 Q5, v6 0, v7 0, v8 ΔQ4 |
Op 28    ÷  | P5/Q5          | v1 0, v2 P5, v5 0, v6 Q5, v14 P5/Q5 |
Op 29 *  ×  | (P5/Q5)·B616   | v14 0, v19 B618, v20 0, v21 B618 |

Unrun "beside the table, the sign of each B: 'B6,6 has a −', 'B6,8 .. +', 'B6,10 .... −', 'B6,12 ... +', 'B6,14 ...... −', 'B6,16 ..... +', 'B6,18 has a sign −'"
Unrun "right of the table: 'Computation of B6,...', a small table of Q and its first, second and third differences ('3rd diff constant'), and a long expansion of B in the variables down the page; read in overview only, not transcribed"
Unrun "faint pencil under the store columns (a+r, a+2r, a+3r, ...; v'12, v'13), apparently left from another notation; not read"

title: BAB/L/019 No. 19, 31 Jul 1840
text:
% BAB/L/019, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001681.
% Cover 222/589 ("No 19", "31 July 1840"); the opened sheet 222/590 with the
% table and, at the right, "No & order of Varble Cards"; the back 222/591
% (222/592 is a second scan of the same back). Read from the zoom images at
% full resolution. See sources/notes/L019.md.
%
% DRAFT (.bab.draft, which build.rs does not read): the sheet needs two
% things the notation does not have, written here as they would be:
%   v6 0 a'     a number "given off & retained": the sheet writes a small 0
%              above and the letter below. The back: "This means give off &
%              retain; thus a is given off from a certain place which is
%              reduced to zero (denoted by the 0 above) & retained at the
%              same place (denoted by the position below) by means of its
%              Complement previously put out."
%   v22 C(a') 0   the complement laid in v22 and given back in the same
%              operation: the sheet writes "C'a" and a small 0 below it.
%   Cards n (v6 v22)(v2 0)...   the sheet's own list of variable cards for
%              each operation, "No & order of Varble Cards", in its notation
%              (first: the variable that gives off, 0 for the mill; second:
%              the variable that receives, 0 for the mill).
% A runnable version, with each retained read written as a read plus a
% transfer, is described in sources/notes/L019.md.
%
% Babbage writes the accents before the letter: 'a is a′, ''b is b″; and d
% is the round ∂. Here a', b'' and d.

Sheet BAB/L/019
No. 19
Date 31 Jul 1840          "31 July 1840"   % cover; the table's "31 July 1840" is written over another date
Title "Notation of the Reduction of the Four Equations"
Image 222/589 cover: the four equations aw + bx + cy + ∂z + e = 0 ('a, ''a, '''a …) "into" Bx + Cy + Dz + E = 0, 'Bx + 'Cy + 'Dz + 'E = 0, ''Bx + ''Cy + ''Dz + ''E = 0
Image 222/590 the table and the variable cards
Image 222/591 back: the meaning of the variable cards and of "give off & retain"

Letters a b c d e a' b' c' d' e' a'' b'' c'' d'' e'' a''' b''' c''' d''' e''' w x y z
% Store headings: v1-v5 a b c ∂ e under "aw + bx + cy + ∂z + e = 0"; v6-v10
% 'a … 'e; v11-v15 ''a … ''e; v16-v20 '''a … '''e. v21 "C.a … C.'''a",
% v22 "C.'a …", v23 unheaded (it holds C''a, C''b, …), v24 and v25
% "Product". A blank column after v5, v10, v15 and v20.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = d, v5 = e, v6 = a', v7 = b', v8 = c', v9 = d', v10 = e', v11 = a'', v12 = b'', v13 = c'', v14 = d'', v15 = e'', v16 = a''', v17 = b''', v18 = c''', v19 = d''', v20 = e'''
Working v21 v22 v23 v24 v25

% Columns: "No of Opn"; braces, each grouping three operations and
% numbered 1 to 4 within each group of twelve, the twelve braced together;
% "Species of Opn"; "Resulting Quantity" (each subtraction written
% "'ab − a'b = B" and so on); "Ingress" and "Egress", empty throughout; the
% store.
Op 1   ×  | a'b            | v6 0 a', v22 C(a') 0, v2 0, v24 a'b |
Cards 1 (v6 v22)(v2 0)(v22 v6)(0 v24)
