title: BAB/L/022 No. 22, 15 Aug 1840
text:
% BAB/L/022, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001723.
% The cover (222/601): "No 22 being a continuation of 21", "15 Aug 1840";
% the opened sheet (222/602): two tables and, for the first, the variable
% cards; the back (340/324): blank. Read from the zoom images at full
% resolution. See sources/notes/L022.md.
%
% DRAFT (hence .bab.draft): rows 8 and 17 do two things in one row, a
% multiplication and the moving of γ (or 'γ) through a complement column
% into the column B (or 'B) has left, and the engine takes every column a
% row leaves at zero as an operand of the operation, so it stops at row 8
% ("× needs two operands; the row gives 3"). With those two moves written
% as rows of their own, the run agrees with 99 of 101 statements; the two
% that do not are the cards of the moves, (v3 v2)(v2 v21), which the
% engine derives as (v3 v21). See the notes.
%
% The sheet writes accents before the letter ('B, ''C, 'γ); here after (B',
% C'', γ'). Its round ∂ is written d. Products in the mill column are
% written as the sheet orders them: "B'C" (B times 'C) is BC' here.

Sheet BAB/L/022
No. 22
Date 15 Aug 1840          "15 Aug 1840"   % cover
Title "Reduction of the three Equations Bx + Cy + Dz + E = 0, 'Bx + 'Cy + 'Dz + 'E = 0, ''Bx + ''Cy + ''Dz + ''E = 0 to two others viz γy + δz + ε = 0, 'γy + 'δz + 'ε = 0 and of these to ∂z + e = 0"
Image 222/601 cover: "No 22 being a continuation of 21"
Image 222/602 the two tables and the cards of the first
Image 340/324 back, blank

Letters B C D E B' C' D' E' B'' C'' D'' E''
Unknowns x y z
Equation B x + C y + D z + E = 0
Equation B' x + C' y + D' z + E' = 0
Equation B'' x + C'' y + D'' z + E'' = 0

% Columns: two numbers to each row, the first (small) running on from No.
% 21 (37 to 60), the second the row's own (1 to 18; then 19, 20, 3, 4, 5, 6);
% a brace for each group of three; the two variables the row operates on
% ("v21 v8"); the operation; the mill's quantity, with "= γ" and the like
% under each difference; an empty, unheaded column; the store v1 to v15,
% "&c", v21 to v30 (v16 to v20 not ruled); an empty column; a column of
% notes ("like C", "like D", "somewhat like E", "not identical with 'C",
% "not identical with 'D", "not identical with 'E", against the groups of
% the first table); a column naming each result (γ, δ, ε, 'γ, 'δ, 'ε); then
% the cards. The first line of the store: v1 0, v2 0, v3 C, v4 D, v5 E,
% v6 0, v7 0, v8 'C, v9 'D, v10 'E, v11 0, v12 0, v13 ''C, v14 ''D,
% v15 ''E; v21 B, v22 0, v23 'B, v24 0, v25 ''B, v26 0; v27 to v30 empty.
% So the B's of the three equations stand in v21, v23, v25, each with a
% complement column beside it (v22, v24, v26); v29 and v30 hold products.
Store v3 = C, v4 = D, v5 = E, v8 = C', v9 = D', v10 = E', v13 = C'', v14 = D'', v15 = E'', v21 = B, v23 = B', v25 = B''
Working v2 v7 v22 v24 v26 v29 v30

% "0 B" below a column: given off and retained; "CB 0" in the column
% beside it: the complement laid and given back, as on L/019 and L/020.
Op 1     ×  | BC'            | v21 0 B, v22 CB 0, v8 0 C', v24 C(C') 0, v29 BC' |   % "v21 v8"
Cards 1 (v21 v22)(v8 v24)(v22 v21)(v24 v8)(0 v29)
Op 2     ×  | B'C            | v23 0 B', v24 CB' 0, v3 0, v30 B'C |                 % "v23 v3"
Cards 2 (v23 v24)(v3 0)(v24 v23)(0 v30)
Op 3     −  | BC'-B'C        | v29 0, v30 0, v3 =γ |                                % the mill: "B'C − 'BC = γ"; notes "like C", "γ"
Cards 3 (v29 0)(v30 0)(0 v3)
Op 4     ×  | BD'            | v21 0 B, v22 CB 0, v9 0 D', v24 C(D') 0, v29 BD' |   % "v21 v9"
Cards 4 (v21 v22)(v9 v24)(v22 v21)(v24 v9)(0 v29)
Op 5     ×  | B'D            | v23 0 B', v24 CB' 0, v4 0, v30 B'D |                 % "v23 v4"
Cards 5 (v23 v24)(v4 0)(v24 v23)(0 v30)
Op 6     −  | BD'-B'D        | v29 0, v30 0, v4 =δ |                                % "= δ"; notes "like D", "δ"
Cards 6 (v29 0)(v30 0)(0 v4)
Op 7     ×  | BE'            | v21 0, v10 0 E', v24 C(E') 0, v29 BE' |              % "v21 v10"; B given off, not retained: its last use
Cards 7 (v21 0)(v10 v24)(v24 v10)(0 v29)
% Row 8 also moves γ from v3 to v21, which B has left empty, through its
% complement in v2: "Cγ 0" in v2, "0" in v3, "γ" in v21, and the cards
% (v3 v2)(v2 v21). A faint pencil curve runs across v2 and v3 here.
Op 8     ×  | B'E            | v23 0 B', v24 CB' 0, v5 0, v30 B'E, v3 0, v2 Cγ 0, v21 γ |   % "v23 v5"
Cards 8 (v23 v24)(v5 0)(v24 v23)(0 v30)(v3 v2)(v2 v21)
Op 9     −  | BE'-B'E        | v29 0, v30 0, v5 =ε |                                % "= ε"; notes "somewhat like E", "ε"
Cards 9 (v29 0)(v30 0)(0 v5)
% "37" at the right, at the end of row 9's cards, above a rule across the
% cards: the cards of rows 1 to 9 (12 + 12 + 13).
Total 37
Op 10    ×  | B'C''          | v23 0 B', v24 CB' 0, v13 0, v29 B'C'' |              % "v23 v13"
Cards 10 (v23 v24)(v13 0)(v24 v23)(0 v29)
Op 11    ×  | B''C'          | v25 0 B'', v26 CB'' 0, v8 0, v30 B''C' |             % "v25 v8"
Cards 11 (v25 v26)(v8 0)(v26 v25)(0 v30)
Op 12    −  | B'C''-B''C'    | v29 0, v30 0, v8 =γ' |                               % "= 'γ"; notes "not identical with 'C", "'γ"
Cards 12 (v29 0)(v30 0)(0 v8)
Op 13    ×  | B'D''          | v23 0 B', v24 CB' 0, v14 0, v29 B'D'' |              % "v23 v14"
Cards 13 (v23 v24)(v14 0)(v24 v23)(0 v29)
Op 14    ×  | B''D'          | v25 0 B'', v26 CB'' 0, v9 0, v30 B''D' |             % "v25 v9"
Cards 14 (v25 v26)(v9 0)(v26 v25)(0 v30)
Op 15    −  | B'D''-B''D'    | v29 0, v30 0, v9 =δ' |                               % "= 'δ"; notes "not identical with 'D", "'δ"
Cards 15 (v29 0)(v30 0)(0 v9)
Op 16    ×  | B'E''          | v23 0, v15 0, v29 B'E'' |                            % "v23 v15"; 'B given off at its last use
Cards 16 (v23 0)(v15 0)(0 v29)
% Row 17 likewise moves 'γ from v8 to v23 through v7: "C'γ 0" in v7, "0"
% in v8, "'γ" in v23; cards (v8 v7)(v7 v23).
Op 17    ×  | B''E'          | v25 0, v10 0, v30 B''E', v8 0, v7 Cγ' 0, v23 γ' |   % "v25 v10"; ''B given off at its last use
Cards 17 (v25 0)(v10 0)(0 v30)(v8 v7)(v7 v23)
Op 18    −  | B'E''-B''E'    | v29 0, v30 0, v10 =ε' |                              % "= 'ε"; notes "not identical with 'E", "'ε"
Cards 18 (v29 0)(v30 0)(0 v10)

% The second table, below a rule, with no cards: under the cards of the
% first, "&c similar" (read in part). Its rows are numbered 19, 20, then
% 3, 4, 5, 6 (running numbers 55 to 60).
Op 19    ×  | γδ'            | v21 0 γ, v22 Cγ 0, v9 0, v29 γδ' |                   % "v21 v9"; the mill "γ'δ"
Op 20    ×  | γ'δ            | v23 0 γ', v24 Cγ' 0, v4 0, v30 γ'δ |                 % "v23 v4"; the mill "'γδ"
Op 3     −  | γδ'-γ'δ        | v29 0, v30 0, v4 =d |                                % "γ'δ − 'γδ = ∂"
Op 4     ×  | γε'            | v21 0, v10 0, v29 γε' |                              % "v21 v10"
Op 5     ×  | γ'ε            | v23 0, v5 0, v30 γ'ε |                               % "v23 v5"
Op 6     −  | γε'-γ'ε        | v29 0, v30 0, v5 =e |                                % "γ'ε − 'γε = e"

Remark "like C"
Remark "like D"
Remark "somewhat like E"
Remark "not identical with 'C"
Remark "not identical with 'D"
Remark "not identical with 'E"
Unrun "below the cards of the first table: '&c similar' (read in part)"
Unrun "a faint pencil curve across v2 and v3 at row 8"
Unrun "top left of the opened sheet, faint pencil: '22'"

name: L023
title: BAB/L/023 No. 23, 7 Jun 1838
text:
% BAB/L/023, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001729.
% The sheet is a looped program, written out as the run of its cards: three
% groups of operation cards, two "backing apparatus" Y and Z that send the
% cards back, and letter cards that advance and go back. Here the cards are
% the program: the engine runs them, and each of the 35 rows is checked
% against what they do. See sources/notes/L023.md.
% Cover 222/603, the opened sheet 222/604, the back 340/325 (blank). Read
% from the zoom images at full resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/023
No. 23
Date 7 Jun 1838          "7 June 1838"   % cover, ink top right and pencil top left; the opened sheet, top right
Title "Notation of a Formula for the Multn of A + Bx + Cx² + ... by a + bx + cx² + ..."
Image 222/603 cover: "By means of combinatorial cards connected with the operation cards. There are three groups of cards. The first makes the combinatorial numbers (in this case the series 1, 2, 3). The second relates to the operations on the coeffts in this case × and +. The third group relates to the use of the combinatorial numbers. The backing apparatus Y backs the cards to the beginning of the formulae cards. The backing apparatus Z backs them to the beginning of the cards forming the combinatorial numbers."
Image 222/604 the table, its operation cards and letter cards above it, and the results to the right
Image 340/325 back, blank

Letters A B C D a b c d

% Above the table, "Operation Cards", in three bracketed groups:
%   "Cards for making the Combinatorial number": ( Diff  Table / +  [a mark
%       like ####] ) "1 Card"
%   "Cards of Formula": ( A / a / × + ) "2 Cards"
%   "Card by which the Combl numbers are used": ( Combl No  1 / +  [a mark
%       like ###, struck] ) "1 Card"
% Below them the letter cards: "a b c d .... Small Letter Cards", "Advance →";
% ".... D C B A" over "A — — — — Large Letter Cards", "Back ←".
% "See Sketch Book Vol 3, p. 228, fig. 1".

% Columns: "Coeff."; "No. of Opern"; "Opern" and "Results of Operation"
% under "Mill"; the "Store": "Δ'", "Tab.", "Combl" (with, small, "This ought
% not to be in Store but on Prisms"), "Const.", "Figure whls of Store" (empty
% throughout); "Great Letter Cards" Advce | Back; "Small letter Cards"
% Advce | Back; "Backg Appas" Z | Y; then "Results".
% v1 = Δ', v2 = Tab, v3 = Comb, v4 = Const. Under each row, `Moves` is
% what the sheet writes in the letter-card columns, and `Backing` what it
% writes in the column of Y or Z. A cell "0 1" in Comb is written so: a 0,
% and the new number after it.
Store v1 = 1, v2 = 0, v3 = 0, v4 = 1   % the first line: Δ' 1, Tab 0, Comb 0, Const 1

% The program: the three groups of cards the cover describes, as the run
% reads them. What each card gives is the engine's reading of the rows: the
% sheet draws the cards (above) but writes their work only in the table.
% S, the sum in the mill, and P, the product, are names here, not columns:
% the sheet's "Figure whls of Store" are empty throughout. The 0 that each
% sum starts from ("0+Ab") is not said by the sheet; here the first card
% sets it.
Deck make     + | v2 = v2 + v1, v3 = v2, S = 0
Deck formula  × | P = Γγ
Deck formula  + | S = S + P
Deck use      − | v3 = v3 - v4
Back Y after use to formula unless v3 = 0   % "The backing apparatus Y backs the cards to the beginning of the formulae cards"
Back Z after use to make                    % "The backing apparatus Z backs them to the beginning of the cards forming the combinatorial numbers"
% Which letter card shows: the sheet moves them by the counts it writes,
% and says nothing of what sets the counts. Here the place is given by Tab
% and Comb, and the sheet's advances and backs are checked against the
% moves that needs. "Advance" is towards D for the great letters and
% towards a for the small, as every row of the sheet has it.
Letter Great Γ = A B C D at v2 - v3 towards D
Letter Small γ = a b c d at v3 - 1 towards a
Result S at Z

% Coeff. 1
Op 1   +  | 0+1         | v2 1, v3 1 |
  Backing Z "Gear Z with prism"
Op 2   ×  | Aa          |            |
  Backing Y "Gear Y with Prism"
Op 3   +  | 0+Aa        |            |
Op 4   −  | 1−1         | v3 0       |
  Backing Z "back"
  Backing Y "ungear Y Back"
% Coeff. 2
Op 5   +  | 1+1         | v2 2, v3 2 |
Op 6   ×  | Ab          |            |
  Moves Great back 0, Small back 1
  Backing Y "gear"
Op 7   +  | 0+Ab        |            |
Op 8   −  | 2−1         | v3 0 1     |
  Backing Y "back"
Op 9   ×  | Ba          |            |
  Moves Great advance 1, Small advance 1
Op 10  +  | (0+Ab)+Ba   |            |
Op 11  −  | 1−1         | v3 0       |
  Backing Z "back"
  Backing Y "ungear back"
% Coeff. 3
Op 12  +  | 2+1         | v2 3, v3 3 |
Op 13  ×  | Ac          |            |
  Moves Great back 1, Small back 2
  Backing Y "gear"
Op 14  +  | 0+Ac        |            |
Op 15  −  | 3−1         | v3 0 2     |
  Backing Y "back"
Op 16  ×  | Bb          |            |
  Moves Great advance 1, Small advance 1
Op 17  +  | (0+Ac)+Bb   |            |
Op 18  −  | 2−1         | v3 0 1     |
  Backing Y "back"
Op 19  ×  | C a          |            |
  Moves Great advance 1, Small advance 1
Op 20  +  | (0+Ac+Bb)+C a |           |
Op 21  −  | 1−1         | v3 0       |
  Backing Z "back"
  Backing Y "ungear back"
% Coeff. 4
Op 22  +  | 3+1         | v2 4, v3 4 |
Op 23  ×  | Ad          |            |   % nothing in Y: no "gear" at this row, as there is at 2, 6 and 13
  Moves Great back 2, Small back 3
Op 24  +  | 0+Ad        |            |
Op 25  −  | 4−1         | v3 0 3     |
  Backing Y "back"
Op 26  ×  | Bc          |            |
  Moves Great advance 1, Small advance 1
Op 27  +  | (0+Ad)+Bc   |            |
Op 28  −  | 3−1         | v3 0 2     |
  Backing Y "back"
Op 29  ×  | C b          |            |
  Moves Great advance 1, Small advance 1
Op 30  +  | (0+Ad+Bc)+C b |           |
Op 31  −  | 2−1         | v3 0 1     |
  Backing Y "back"
Op 32  ×  | Da          |            |   % the two 1s stand a little low, on the line of 33; the dashed line above 32 puts them with 32
  Moves Great advance 1, Small advance 1
Op 33  +  | (0+Ad+Bc+C b)+Da |        |
Op 34  −  | 1−1         | v3 0 0     |   % "0 0" here; rows 4, 11 and 21 write a single 0
  Backing Z "back"
  Backing Y "ungear Back"
% (the table ends with the first row of Coeff. 5)
Op 35  +  | 4+1         | v2 5, v3 5 |

% "Results", to the right, beside the rows that make them: Aa; Ab, Ba; Ac,
% Bb, Ca; Ad, Bc, Cb, Da; and below each group:
Find c0 = Aa                  "Aa coeff of x⁰"
Find c1 = Ab + Ba             "Ab + Ba coeff of x¹"
Find c2 = Ac + Bb + C a        "Ac + Bb + Ca coeff of x²"
Find c3 = Ad + Bc + C b + Da   "Ad + Bc + Cb + Da Coeff. of x³"

Remark "NB. The ungearing and gearing again of y is only necessary if in passing to its own Zero it gives any orders"
Remark "Opn Cards in this Notn denote the sum of the Cards"   % the first word read uncertainly
% "NB. 252·5 hours reqd to obtain 100 terms of the Product see p 200 Vol 3
% Sketch book". Sketch Book Vol 3 p 200 (headed 6 [?] June 1838, the day
% before this sheet) works it out: "5050 Mult." at 2 minutes, 10100 min;
% "15150 add", × 6 turns ÷ 20 turns a minute, 4545 min; and a 505 not read
% with confidence: 15150 minutes, 252·5 hours. The run checks the counts in
% that working: 100 terms take 5050 multiplication cards, and 15150 cards of
% the formula and of the use of the combinatorial numbers (× + −). Whether
% Babbage's "15150 add" counts the same cards is not certain; the minutes
% are his and are not checked. See sources/notes/codesign-L023.md.
Count 100 results = 5050 cards of formula ×      "5050 Mult."
Count 100 results = 15150 cards of formula use   "15150 add"
Remark "NB. 252·5 hours reqd to obtain 100 terms of the Product see p 200 Vol 3 Sketch book"
Unrun "cover, top right, in pencil, inside a pencil loop: '23' and faint words, perhaps 'To be drawn'; a small ink mark like 'M'"
Unrun "cover, top: two pairs of brackets showing through from the table's heading on the other side"

name: L024-1
title: BAB/L/024 No. 24.1
text:
% BAB/L/024, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001732.
% Two images: 222/605, the cover (right) and a blank page (left, "34" in
% pencil at its top left); 222/606, the opened sheet with two tables. This
% page is the upper table. The sheet is not dated; "24" in pencil at the top
% right of the cover. Rojas 2017 lists program 24 as 10.1838, a recursion.
% Read from the zoom images at full resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/024
No. 24.1
Title "Notations for determining Px+1 from Px, Px+1 = (Wx/Vx).Px, Wx & Vx being both quadratic functions of x"
Image 222/605 cover: "Notations for determining Px+1 from Px ... If Wx = (s+x)² & Vx = (1+x)² & P0 = 2, bs(0) = P0 + P1η² + P2η⁴ + ... Pxη^2x + ..., η = a/a', a' > a, Mec. Cel. Prem. par. p 271. W0 = s², ΔW0 = 1 + 2s, Δ²W = 2; V0 = 1, ΔV0 = 3, Δ²V = 2"
Image 222/606 the upper table

% The table is written for any quadratic W and V: its letters are W0, ΔW0,
% Δ²W, V0, ΔV0, Δ²V and P0, as in the heading of the store. Wk, ΔWk, Vk,
% ΔVk and Pk, which the cells write, are defined below from those letters
% and from the cover's Px+1 = (Wx/Vx)·Px, so that every cell is checked
% against what its symbol means.
Letters W0 ΔW0 Δ²W V0 ΔV0 Δ²V P0
Let W1 = W0 + ΔW0
Let W2 = W0 + 2ΔW0 + Δ²W
Let W3 = W0 + 3ΔW0 + 3Δ²W
Let ΔW1 = ΔW0 + Δ²W
Let ΔW2 = ΔW0 + 2Δ²W
Let V1 = V0 + ΔV0
Let V2 = V0 + 2ΔV0 + Δ²V
Let V3 = V0 + 3ΔV0 + 3Δ²V
Let ΔV1 = ΔV0 + Δ²V
Let ΔV2 = ΔV0 + 2Δ²V
Let P1 = (W0/V0)·P0
Let P2 = (W1/V1)·P1
Let P3 = (W2/V2)·P2
Let P4 = (W3/V3)·P3

% The store's first line: v1 W0, v2 0, v3 ΔW0, v4 0, v5 Δ²W, v6 0, v7 V0,
% v8 0, v9 ΔV0, v10 0, v11 Δ²V, v12 0, v13 P0, and P0 again in v16 (beyond
% the column of operation numbers, which stands between v15 and v16).
% Each number has a column beside it, at 0, into which it is laid as it is
% read, so that the pairs change places at each use.
Store v1 = W0, v3 = ΔW0, v5 = Δ²W, v7 = V0, v9 = ΔV0, v11 = Δ²V, v13 = P0, v16 = P0
Working v2 v4 v6 v8 v10 v12 v14 v15 v17 v18 v19 v20

% No right-hand column. Faint pencil, as if erased or offset from another
% sheet, stands in many rows (the first line of the store again in row 2;
% v9 to v20 written small across row 1; P's in v15); only the ink is
% transcribed.
Op 1   ÷  | W0/V0       | v1 0, v2 W0, v7 0, v8 V0, v14 W0/V0 |

name: L026-1
title: BAB/L/026 No. 26.1
text:
% BAB/L/026, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001735.
% Two images: 222/615, the sheet with two tables, "Calculation of the
% numerical value of x = (ab + cd)/(a + c)" above and "Another method for the
% same" below; 222/613, the back, ruled and blank but for "BAB [L] 26".
% No date on either image. This page is the upper table. Read from the zoom
% images at full resolution. See sources/notes/L026.md.

Sheet BAB/L/026
No. 26.1
Title "Calculation of the numerical value of x = (ab + cd)/(a + c)"
Image 222/615 upper table and its right-hand column
Image 222/613 back: blank but for "BAB [L] 26"

% The fourth letter is written ∂; here d.
Letters a b c d
Find x = (ab+cd)/(a+c)

% Columns: "No. of Open", "Operation", "Mill", then the "Store", v1 to v10,
% a b c ∂ in v1 to v4. v10 is never used.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = d
Working v5 v6 v7 v8 v9

% No 0 anywhere. Each number that goes to the mill is marked by an arrow,
% "←", in its column, and no column is cleared: c is taken at operation 2
% and again at 4, a at 1 and again at 4. Each arrow is written here as
% the sheet writes it, ←: given to the mill, and the column kept. The arrows in
% v1 and v2 at operation 1 and in v4 at operation 2 have a short hook at
% the tail (as "←˥"); the others are plain.
% The right-hand column, written to the right of the table, without accents:
% "v1 = a v2 = b v3 = c v4 = ∂", "v5 = v1v2", "v6 = v3v4", "v7 = v5 + v6",
% "v8 = v1 + v3", then the composition below.
Op 1     ×  | ab            | v1 ←, v2 ←, v5 ab          | v5 = v1·v2
Op 2     ×  | cd            | v3 ←, v4 ←, v6 cd          | v6 = v3·v4
Op 3     +  | ab+cd         | v5 ←, v6 ←, v7 ab+cd       | v7 = v5+v6
Op 4     +  | a+c           | v1 ←, v3 ←, v8 a+c         | v8 = v1+v3      % the mill column "a + ∂c", the ∂ (or c) written over; a faint pencil arrow in v2, rubbed out
Op 5     ÷  | (ab+cd)/(a+c) | v7 ←, v8 ←, v9 =x          | x = v9 = v7/v8  % the mill column writes "(ab + c∂)/(a + c) = x"; v9 "(ab + c∂)/(a + c)"

Composition x = v9 = v7/v8 = (v5+v6)/(v1+v3) = (v1·v2+v3·v4)/(v1+v3) = (ab+cd)/(a+c)

Unrun "the arrows of operation 1 (v1, v2) and operation 2 (v4) have a hook at the tail; the others are plain"

name: L026-2
title: BAB/L/026 No. 26.2
text:
% BAB/L/026, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001735.
% The lower table of the sheet (image 222/615), "Another method for the
% same". No date. Read from the zoom images at full resolution. See
% sources/notes/L026.md.

Sheet BAB/L/026
No. 26.2
Title "Another method for the same x = (ab + cd)/(a + c) = (ab + bc - bc + cd)/(a + c) = b + (∂ - b)c/(a + c)"
Image 222/615 lower table and its right-hand column

% The fourth letter is written ∂; here d.
Letters a b c d
Find x = (ab+cd)/(a+c)

% The store is headed v1 to v10 again, a b c ∂ in v1 to v4; v10 unused.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = d
Working v5 v6 v7 v8 v9

% As in the upper table: arrows "←" (all plain here), no 0, no column
% cleared: b goes to the mill at operations 1 and 5, c at 2 and 3. Written
% G.R. The right-hand column, without accents: "v5 = v4 − v2", "v6 = v1 +
% v3", "v7 = v5v3", "v8 = v7/v6", then the composition below.
Op 1     −  | d-b              | v2 ←, v4 ←, v5 d-b                  | v5 = v4-v2
Op 2     +  | a+c              | v1 ←, v3 ←, v6 a+c                  | v6 = v1+v3
Op 3     ×  | (d-b)c           | v3 ←, v5 ←, v7 (d-b)c               | v7 = v5·v3
Op 4     ÷  | ((d-b)c)/(a+c)   | v6 ←, v7 ←, v8 ((d-b)c)/(a+c)       | v8 = v7/v6
Op 5     +  | b+((d-b)c)/(a+c) | v2 ←, v8 ←, v9 =x                   | x = v9 = v2+v8   % the mill column writes "b + (∂ − b)c/(a + c) = x"; v9 "b + (∂ − b)c/(a + c)"

% The heading, and the right-hand column's composition:
Composition x = (ab+cd)/(a+c) = (ab+bc-bc+cd)/(a+c) = b+((d-b)c)/(a+c)
Composition x = v9 = v2+v8 = v2+v7/v6 = v2+(v5·v3)/(v1+v3) = v2+((v4-v2)v3)/(v1+v3) = b+((d-b)c)/(a+c)

Unrun "pencil, below the right-hand column, struck through: 'x = (ab + ∂)/(a + c) = b/c + ∂/a'"

name: L027
title: BAB/L/027 No. 27
text:
% BAB/L/027, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001736.
% Two images: 222/617, the folded cover (left half blank; right half "List of
% Variables their signs & coefficients", pencil working, "BAB [L27]",
% "E.-1905"); 222/620 (7838 × 6342), the opened sheet: five bands of store
% columns, drawn, with no operations. Read from the zoom images at full
% resolution; the pencil with its contrast raised. See sources/notes/L027.md.
%
% NOTHING TO RUN. The sheet has no operations, no mill and no values: every
% column is drawn as a sign wheel (a circle, with + in it or empty) over four
% figure wheels each at 0, with what the column is for written beneath it
% (x², sin 2θ, log(a+x), n·n+1/1·2 ...), and rows of dots for columns left
% out. A `Store v2 = x` line would say that v2 holds x; the sheet says only
% that a column is set aside for x and stands at zero. So the columns are
% kept below as comments, band by band, and the page checks no statements.
%
% "⊕" is a circle with + in it; "○" an empty circle; "…" a column of dots.
% Each column: the circle, four 0s, the label.
%
% Band 1 (powers and products). In pencil above the first columns, faint:
% "v1"(?) over x⁰, "v2" "v3" "v4" "v5" over x, x², x³, x⁴, "v7" (or v6) over
% the column of dots, "v8" over the second x.
%   x⁰ (whole column in pencil: "(+)", four 0s, "x⁰")
%   ⊕ x, ⊕ x², ⊕ x³, ⊕ x⁴, … ("x⁵"? faint in pencil in the label), ⊕ x, ⊕ x²,
%   ⊕ x³, ⊕ x⁴, …, …, ⊕ a⁰, ⊕ a¹, ⊕ a², ⊕ a³, …, ⊕ b⁰, ⊕ b¹, ⊕ b², ⊕ b³, …,
%   ⊕ y⁰, ⊕ y¹, ⊕ y², ⊕ y³, …, ⊕ xy, ⊕ x²y, ⊕ xy², ⊕ x³y, ⊕ x²y², ⊕ xy³, …,
%   ○ z⁰, ○ z¹, ○ z², ○ z³, …, ○ xz, ○ yz, and in pencil "xy/z" (?), …
%
% Band 2 (circular functions).
%   ⊕ sin θ, ⊕ sin 2θ, ⊕ sin 3θ, …, ⊕ sin θ, ⊕ sin 2θ, ○ sin 3θ, …,
%   ⊕ sin η, ⊕ sin 2η, ⊕ sin 3η, …, …, ⊕ cos θ, ⊕ cos 2θ, ⊕ cos 3θ, …, …,
%   ⊕ cos θ, ⊕ cos 2θ, ⊕ cos 3θ, …, …, ⊕ sin α, ⊕ sin(α+β), …, ⊕ cos α,
%   ⊕ cos(α+β), …; then in pencil, labels only: "ε^x" (?), "ε^(−x)/2" (?),
%   "a√−1", "x√−1", "ε^(x√−1)", "ε^(−x√−1)".
